⊢ isEmpty (copy_shape LN LN) ∧ (∀y. isEmpty (copy_shape LN ⦕ 0 ↦ y ⦖)) ∧
  (∀t2 t1. copy_shape LN (BN t1 t2) = BN (copy_shape LN t1) (copy_shape LN t2)) ∧
  (∀y t2 t1. isEmpty (copy_shape LN (BS t1 y t2))) ∧ (∀x. copy_shape ⦕ 0 ↦ x ⦖ LN = ⦕ 0 ↦ x ⦖) ∧
  (∀y x. copy_shape ⦕ 0 ↦ x ⦖ ⦕ 0 ↦ y ⦖ = ⦕ 0 ↦ x ⦖) ∧ (∀x t2 t1. copy_shape ⦕ 0 ↦ x ⦖ (BN t1 t2) = ⦕ 0 ↦ x ⦖) ∧
  (∀y x t2 t1. copy_shape ⦕ 0 ↦ x ⦖ (BS t1 y t2) = BS (copy_shape LN t1) x (copy_shape LN t2)) ∧
  (∀u2 u1. copy_shape (BN u1 u2) LN = if domain (BN u1 u2) = ∅ then LN else BN u1 u2) ∧
  (∀y u2 u1. copy_shape (BN u1 u2) ⦕ 0 ↦ y ⦖ = BN u1 u2) ∧
  (∀u2 u1 t2 t1. copy_shape (BN u1 u2) (BN t1 t2) = BN (copy_shape u1 t1) (copy_shape u2 t2)) ∧
  (∀y u2 u1 t2 t1. copy_shape (BN u1 u2) (BS t1 y t2) = BN u1 u2) ∧
  (∀x u2 u1. copy_shape (BS u1 x u2) LN = BS u1 x u2) ∧
  (∀y x u2 u1. copy_shape (BS u1 x u2) ⦕ 0 ↦ y ⦖ = if domain (BN u1 u2) = ∅ then ⦕ 0 ↦ x ⦖ else BS u1 x u2) ∧
  (∀x u2 u1 t2 t1. copy_shape (BS u1 x u2) (BN t1 t2) = BS u1 x u2) ∧
  ∀y x u2 u1 t2 t1. copy_shape (BS u1 x u2) (BS t1 y t2) = BS (copy_shape u1 t1) x (copy_shape u2 t2)

name: dopen_free_dec_def_primitive
pretty:
⊢ dopen_free_dec =
  WFREC
    (@R. WF R ∧ (∀mn ds x. MEM x ds ⇒ R x (Dmod mn ds)) ∧ (∀lds ds x. MEM x ds ⇒ R x (Dlocal lds ds)) ∧
         ∀ds lds x. MEM x lds ⇒ R x (Dlocal lds ds))
    (λdopen_free_dec a.
       case a of
         Dlet locs p e => I T
       | Dletrec locs' funs => I T
       | Dtype locs'' tdefs => I T
       | Dtabbrev locs'³' tvs tn t => I T
       | Dexn locs'⁴' cn ts => I T
       | Dmod mn ds => I (EVERY dopen_free_dec ds)
       | Dlocal lds ds' => I (EVERY dopen_free_dec lds ∧ EVERY dopen_free_dec ds')

name: call_FFI_def
pretty:
⊢ ∀st s conf bytes.
    call_FFI st s conf bytes =
    if s ≠ ExtCall «» then
      case st.oracle s st.ffi_state conf bytes of
        Oracle_return ffi' bytes' =>
          if LENGTH bytes' = LENGTH bytes then
            FFI_return
              (st with <|ffi_state := ffi'; io_events := st.io_events ++ [IO_event s conf (ZIP (bytes,bytes'))]|>)
              bytes'
          else FFI_final (Final_event s conf bytes FFI_failed)

    else FFI_return st bytes

name: read_string_def
pretty:
⊢ ∀str s loc.
    read_string str s loc =
    if str = "" then (ErrorS,loc,"")
    else if HD str = #"\"" then (StringS s,loc,TL str)
    else if HD str = #"\n" then (ErrorS,next_line loc,TL str)
    else if HD str ≠ #"\\" then read_string (TL str) (STRCAT s (STRING (HD str) "")) (next_loc 1 loc)
    else
      case TL str of
        "" => (ErrorS,loc,TL str)
      | STRING #"\\" cs => read_string cs (STRCAT s "\\") (next_loc 2 loc)
      | STRING #"\"" cs => read_string cs (STRCAT s "\"") (next_loc 2 loc)
      | STRING #"a" cs => read_string cs (STRCAT s "\a") (next_loc 2 loc)
      | STRING #"b" cs => read_string cs (STRCAT s "\b") (next_loc 2 loc)
      | STRING #"t" cs => read_string cs (STRCAT s "\t") (next_loc 2 loc)
      | STRING #"n" cs => read_string cs (STRCAT s "\n") (next_loc 2 loc)
      | STRING #"v" cs => read_string cs (STRCAT s "\v") (next_loc 2 loc)
      | STRING #"f" cs => read_string cs (STRCAT s "\f") (next_loc 2 loc)
      | STRING #"r" cs => read_string cs (STRCAT s "\r") (next_loc 2 loc)
      | STRING c cs =>
        if isDigit c then
          case read_char_as_3digits (STRING c cs) of
            NONE => (ErrorS,loc,STRING c cs)
          | SOME (v1,v2) => read_string v2 (STRCAT s (STRING v1 "")) (next_loc 4 loc)

      if str ≠ "" ∧ c = #"0" ∧ HD str = #"w" then
        if TL str = "" then SOME (ErrorS,Locs loc loc,"")
        else if isDigit (HD (TL str)) then
          (let
             (n,rest) = read_while isDigit (TL str) ""
           in
             SOME (WordS (toNum n),Locs loc (next_loc (STRLEN n + 1) loc),rest))
        else if HD (TL str) = #"x" then
          (let
             (n,rest) = read_while isHexDigit (TL (TL str)) ""
           in
             SOME (WordS (num_from_hex_string n),Locs loc (next_loc (STRLEN n + 2) loc),rest))
        else SOME (ErrorS,Locs loc loc,TL str)
      else if str ≠ "" ∧ c = #"0" ∧ HD str = #"x" then
        (let
           (n,rest) = read_while isHexDigit (TL str) ""
         in
           SOME (NumberS (&num_from_hex_string n),Locs loc (next_loc (STRLEN n) loc),rest))
      else
        (let
           (n,rest) = read_while isDigit str ""
         in
           SOME (NumberS (&toNum (STRING c n)),Locs loc (next_loc (STRLEN n) loc),rest))
    else if c = #"~" ∧ str ≠ "" ∧ isDigit (HD str) then
      (let
         (n,rest) = read_while isDigit str ""
       in
         SOME (NumberS (0 − &toNum n),Locs loc (next_loc (STRLEN n + 1) loc),rest))
    else if c = #"'" then
      (let
         (n,rest) = read_while isAlphaNumPrime str (STRING c "")
       in
         SOME (OtherS n,Locs loc (next_loc (STRLEN n − 1) loc),rest))
    else if c = #"\"" then (let (t,loc',rest) = read_string str "" (next_loc 1 loc) in SOME (t,Locs loc loc',rest))
    else if "*)" ≼ STRING c str then SOME (ErrorS,Locs loc (next_loc 2 loc),TL str)
    else if "#\"" ≼ STRING c str then
      (let (t,loc',rest) = read_string (TL str) "" (next_loc 2 loc) in SOME (mkCharS t,Locs loc loc',rest))
    else if "#(" ≼ STRING c str then
      (let (t,loc',rest) = read_FFIcall (TL str) "" (next_loc 2 loc) in SOME (t,Locs loc loc',rest))
    else if "(*" ≼ STRING c str then
      case skip_comment (TL str) 0 (next_loc 2 loc) of
        NONE => SOME (ErrorS,Locs loc (next_loc 2 loc),"")
      | SOME (rest,loc') => next_sym rest loc'
    else if c = #"_" then SOME (OtherS "_",Locs loc loc,str)
    else (let (tok,end_loc,rest) = read_Ident (STRING c str) loc [] in SOME (tok,Locs loc end_loc,rest))

name: nsSub_refl
pretty: ⊢ ∀P R. (∀n x. P n x ⇒ R n x x) ⇒ ∀e. nsAll P e ⇒ nsSub R e e

name: nsSub_nsMap
pretty: ⊢ ∀R f n1 n2. nsSub R (nsMap f n1) (nsMap f n2) ⇔ nsSub (λid x y. R id (f x) (f y)) n1 n2

name: nsSub_nsEmpty
pretty: ⊢ ∀r env. nsSub r nsEmpty env

name: nsSub_nsBind
pretty: ⊢ ∀R x v1 v2 e1 e2. R (Short x) v1 v2 ∧ nsSub R e1 e2 ⇒ nsSub R (nsBind x v1 e1) (nsBind x v2 e2)

name: nsSub_nsAppend_lift
pretty:
⊢ ∀R mn e1 e1' e2 e2'.
    nsSub (λid. R (Long mn id)) e1 e1' ∧ nsSub R e2 e2' ⇒
    nsSub R (nsAppend (nsLift mn e1) e2) (nsAppend (nsLift mn e1') e2')

name: nsSub_nsAppend2
pretty: ⊢ ∀R e1 e2 e2'. nsSub R e1 e1 ∧ nsSub R e2 e2' ⇒ nsSub R (nsAppend e1 e2) (nsAppend e1 e2')

name: nsSub_mono2
pretty: ⊢ (∀x y z. nsLookup e1 x = SOME y ∧ nsLookup e2 x = SOME z ∧ R1 x y z ⇒ R2 x y z) ⇒ nsSub R1 e1 e2 ⇒ nsSub R2 e1 e2

name: nsSub_mono
pretty: ⊢ (∀x y z. R1 x y z ⇒ R2 x y z) ⇒ nsSub R1 e1 e2 ⇒ nsSub R2 e1 e2

name: nsSub_conj
pretty: ⊢ ∀P Q e1 e2. nsSub (λid x y. P id x y ∧ Q id x y) e1 e2 ⇔ nsSub P e1 e2 ∧ nsSub Q e1 e2

name: nsSub_compute_ind
pretty:
⊢ ∀P. (∀path R e1V e1M e2V e2M.
         (∀k v1 v2. ALOOKUP e1M k = SOME v1 ∧ ALOOKUP e2M k = SOME v2 ⇒ P (k::path) R v1 v2) ⇒
         P path R (Bind e1V e1M) (Bind e2V e2M)) ⇒
      ∀v v1 v2 v3. P v v1 v2 v3

name: nsSub_compute_def
pretty:
⊢ ∀path e2V e2M e1V e1M R.
    nsSub_compute path R (Bind e1V e1M) (Bind e2V e2M) ⇔
    alistSub (λk v1 v2. R (mk_id (REVERSE path) k) v1 v2) e1V e2V ∧
    alistSub (λk v1 v2. nsSub_compute (k::path) R v1 v2) e1M e2M

name: nsOpen_some_from_same_mod_domain
pretty:
⊢ nsOpen path env1 = SOME opened1 ∧ (∀p. nsLookupMod env1 p = NONE ⇔ nsLookupMod env2 p = NONE) ⇒
  ∃opened2. nsOpen path env2 = SOME opened2

name: nsOpen_nsMap
pretty: ⊢ nsOpen path (nsMap f env) = OPTION_MAP (nsMap f) (nsOpen path env)

name: nsOpen_nil
pretty: ⊢ nsOpen [] env = NONE

name: nsOpen_eq_some
pretty: ⊢ nsOpen path env = SOME opened ⇔ path ≠ [] ∧ nsLookupMod env path = SOME opened

name: nsOpen_cons
pretty: ⊢ nsOpen (mn::path) env = nsLookupMod env (mn::path)

name: nsMap_nsSing
pretty: ⊢ ∀f x v. nsMap f (nsSing x v) = nsSing x (f v)

name: nsMap_nsEmpty
pretty: ⊢ ∀f. nsMap f nsEmpty = nsEmpty

name: nsMap_nsAppend
pretty: ⊢ ∀n1 n2 f. nsMap f (nsAppend n1 n2) = nsAppend (nsMap f n1) (nsMap f n2)

name: nsMap_I
pretty: ⊢ ∀ns. nsMap I ns = ns

name: nsMap_compose
pretty: ⊢ ∀g e f. nsMap f (nsMap g e) = nsMap (f ∘ g) e

name: nsMap_alist_to_ns
pretty: ⊢ ∀f l. nsMap f (alist_to_ns l) = alist_to_ns (MAP (λ(k,v). (k,f v)) l)

name: nsLookupMod_nsSing
pretty: ⊢ ∀n1 n2 v. nsLookupMod (nsSing n2 v) n1 = if n1 = [] then SOME (nsSing n2 v) else NONE

name: nsLookupMod_nsMap
pretty: ⊢ ∀n x f. nsLookupMod (nsMap f n) x = OPTION_MAP (nsMap f) (nsLookupMod n x)

name: nsLookupMod_nsLift
pretty:
⊢ ∀mn e path.
    nsLookupMod (nsLift mn e) path =
    case path of [] => SOME (nsLift mn e) | mn'::path' => if mn = mn' then nsLookupMod e path' else NONE

name: nsLookupMod_nsEmpty
pretty: ⊢ ∀x y. nsLookupMod nsEmpty (x::y) = NONE

name: nsLookupMod_nsAppend_some
pretty:
⊢ ∀e1 e2 path.
    nsLookupMod (nsAppend e1 e2) path = SOME x ⇔
    if path = [] then x = nsAppend e1 e2
    else
      nsLookupMod e1 path = SOME x ∨
      nsLookupMod e2 path = SOME x ∧ ∀p1 p2. p1 ≠ [] ∧ path = p1 ++ p2 ⇒ nsLookupMod e1 p1 = NONE

name: nsLookupMod_nsAppend_none
pretty:
⊢ ∀e1 e2 path.
    nsLookupMod (nsAppend e1 e2) path = NONE ⇔
    nsLookupMod e1 path = NONE ∧
    (nsLookupMod e2 path = NONE ∨ ∃p1 p2 e3. p1 ≠ [] ∧ path = p1 ++ p2 ∧ nsLookupMod e1 p1 = SOME e3)

name: nsLookupMod_FOLDR_nsLift_none
pretty: ⊢ ∀e p1 p2. nsLookupMod (FOLDR nsLift e p1) p2 = NONE ⇔ p2 ≼ p1 ∨ p1 ≼ p2 ⇒ ∃p3. p2 = p1 ++ p3 ∧ nsLookupMod e p3 = NONE

name: nsLookupMod_append
pretty:
⊢ nsLookupMod env (path ++ suffix) =
  case nsLookupMod env path of NONE => NONE | SOME opened => nsLookupMod opened suffix

name: nsLookupMod_alist_to_ns
pretty: ⊢ ∀l x y. nsLookupMod (alist_to_ns l) (x::y) = NONE

name: nsLookupMod_after_nsOpen
pretty: ⊢ nsOpen path env = SOME opened ⇒ nsLookupMod opened suffix = nsLookupMod env (path ++ suffix)

name: nsLookupMod_after_nsLookupMod
pretty: ⊢ nsLookupMod env path = SOME opened ⇒ nsLookupMod opened suffix = nsLookupMod env (path ++ suffix)

name: nsLookup_to_nsLookupMod
pretty: ⊢ ∀n v t. nsLookup n v = SOME t ⇒ ∃m. nsLookupMod n (id_to_mods v) = SOME m ∧ nsLookup m (Short (id_to_n v)) = SOME t

name: nsLookup_nsSing
pretty: ⊢ ∀n v id. nsLookup (nsSing n v) id = if id = Short n then SOME v else NONE

name: nsLookup_nsMap
pretty: ⊢ ∀n x f. nsLookup (nsMap f n) x = OPTION_MAP f (nsLookup n x)

name: nsLookup_nsLift_append
pretty:
⊢ ∀m ns ns' m' id n.
    nsLookup (nsAppend (nsLift m ns) ns') (Short n) = nsLookup ns' (Short n) ∧
    nsLookup (nsAppend (nsLift m ns) ns') (Long m' id) = if m = m' then nsLookup ns id else nsLookup ns' (Long m' id)

name: nsLookup_nsLift
pretty:
⊢ ∀mn e id.
    nsLookup (nsLift mn e) id = case id of Short v => NONE | Long mn' id' => if mn = mn' then nsLookup e id' else NONE

name: nsLookup_nsEmpty
pretty: ⊢ ∀id. nsLookup nsEmpty id = NONE

name: nsLookup_nsDom
pretty: ⊢ ∀x n. x ∈ nsDom n ⇔ ∃v. nsLookup n x = SOME v

name: nsLookup_nsBind
pretty:
⊢ (∀n v e. nsLookup (nsBind n v e) (Short n) = SOME v) ∧
  ∀n n' v e. n ≠ Short n' ⇒ nsLookup (nsBind n' v e) n = nsLookup e n

name: nsLookup_nsAppend_some
pretty:
⊢ ∀e1 id e2 v.
    nsLookup (nsAppend e1 e2) id = SOME v ⇔
    nsLookup e1 id = SOME v ∨
    nsLookup e1 id = NONE ∧ nsLookup e2 id = SOME v ∧
    ∀p1 p2. p1 ≠ [] ∧ id_to_mods id = p1 ++ p2 ⇒ nsLookupMod e1 p1 = NONE

name: nsLookup_nsAppend_none
pretty:
⊢ ∀e1 id e2.
    nsLookup (nsAppend e1 e2) id = NONE ⇔
    nsLookup e1 id = NONE ∧
    (nsLookup e2 id = NONE ∨ ∃p1 p2 e3. p1 ≠ [] ∧ id_to_mods id = p1 ++ p2 ∧ nsLookupMod e1 p1 = SOME e3)

name: nsLookup_nsAll
pretty: ⊢ ∀env x P v. nsAll P env ∧ nsLookup env x = SOME v ⇒ P x v

name: nsLookup_namespaceSET3
pretty: ⊢ ∀ns id v. nsLookup ns id = SOME v ⇒ v ∈ namespaceSET3 ns

name: nsLookup_FOLDR_nsLift_some
pretty:
⊢ ∀e p id v.
    nsLookup (FOLDR nsLift e p) id = SOME v ⇔
    p = [] ∧ nsLookup e id = SOME v ∨ p ≠ [] ∧ ∃p2 n. id = mk_id (p ++ p2) n ∧ nsLookup e (mk_id p2 n) = SOME v

name: nsLookup_FOLDR_nsLift
pretty: ⊢ ∀e p k. nsLookup (FOLDR nsLift e p) (mk_id p k) = nsLookup e (Short k)

name: nsLookup_Bind_v_some
pretty: ⊢ nsLookup (Bind v []) k = SOME x ⇔ ∃y. k = Short y ∧ ALOOKUP v y = SOME x

name: nsLookup_alist_to_ns_some
pretty: ⊢ ∀l id v. nsLookup (alist_to_ns l) id = SOME v ⇔ ∃x'. id = Short x' ∧ ALOOKUP l x' = SOME v

name: nsLookup_alist_to_ns_none
pretty: ⊢ ∀l id. nsLookup (alist_to_ns l) id = NONE ⇔ ∀x'. id = Short x' ⇒ ALOOKUP l x' = NONE

name: nsLookup_after_nsOpen
pretty: ⊢ nsOpen path env = SOME opened ⇒ nsLookup opened id = nsLookup env (mk_id (path ++ id_to_mods id) (id_to_n id))

name: nsLookup_after_nsLookupMod
pretty:
⊢ ∀env path opened id.
    nsLookupMod env path = SOME opened ⇒ nsLookup env (mk_id (path ++ id_to_mods id) (id_to_n id)) = nsLookup opened id

name: nsLift_nsMap
pretty: ⊢ ∀f n mn. nsLift mn (nsMap f n) = nsMap f (nsLift mn n)

name: nsDomMod_nsSing
pretty: ⊢ ∀x y. nsDomMod (nsSing x y) = {[]}

name: nsDomMod_nsLift
pretty: ⊢ ∀mn n. nsDomMod (nsLift mn n) = [] INSERT IMAGE (CONS mn) (nsDomMod n)

name: nsDomMod_nsEmpty
pretty: ⊢ nsDomMod nsEmpty = {[]}

name: nsDomMod_nsBind
pretty: ⊢ ∀x y n. nsDomMod (nsBind x y n) = nsDomMod n

name: nsDomMod_nsAppend_flat
pretty: ⊢ ∀n1 n2. nsDomMod n1 = {[]} ⇒ nsDomMod (nsAppend n1 n2) = nsDomMod n2

name: nsDomMod_alist_to_ns
pretty: ⊢ ∀l. nsDomMod (alist_to_ns l) = {[]}

name: nsDom_nsSing
pretty: ⊢ ∀x y. nsDom (nsSing x y) = {Short x}

name: nsDom_nsLift
pretty: ⊢ ∀mn n. nsDom (nsLift mn n) = IMAGE (Long mn) (nsDom n)

name: nsDom_nsEmpty
pretty: ⊢ nsDom nsEmpty = ∅

name: nsDom_nsBind
pretty: ⊢ ∀x y n. nsDom (nsBind x y n) = Short x INSERT nsDom n

name: nsDom_nsAppend_flat
pretty: ⊢ ∀n1 n2. nsDomMod n1 = {[]} ⇒ nsDom (nsAppend n1 n2) = nsDom n1 ∪ nsDom n2

name: nsDom_nsAppend_equal
pretty:
⊢ ∀n1 n2 n3 n4.
    nsDom n1 = nsDom n3 ∧ nsDom n2 = nsDom n4 ∧ nsDomMod n1 = nsDomMod n3 ∧ nsDomMod n2 = nsDomMod n4 ⇒
    nsDom (nsAppend n1 n2) = nsDom (nsAppend n3 n4) ∧ nsDomMod (nsAppend n1 n2) = nsDomMod (nsAppend n3 n4)

name: nsDom_nsAppend_alist
pretty: ⊢ ∀x y. nsDom (nsAppend (alist_to_ns x) y) = set (MAP (Short ∘ FST) x) ∪ nsDom y

name: nsDom_alist_to_ns
pretty: ⊢ ∀l. nsDom (alist_to_ns l) = set (MAP (Short ∘ FST) l)

name: nsBindList_short_lookup
pretty:
⊢ ∀bindings name env.
    nsLookup (nsBindList bindings env) (Short name) =
    case ALOOKUP bindings name of NONE => nsLookup env (Short name) | SOME v => SOME v

name: nsBindList_long_lookup
pretty: ⊢ ∀bindings env m name. nsLookup (nsBindList bindings env) (Long m name) = nsLookup env (Long m name)

name: nsBindList_LIST_REL_lookup
pretty:
⊢ ∀bindings bindings' env env' id.
    LIST_REL (λ(x,v) (y,w). x = y ∧ R v w) bindings bindings' ∧ OPTREL R (nsLookup env id) (nsLookup env' id) ⇒
    OPTREL R (nsLookup (nsBindList bindings env) id) (nsLookup (nsBindList bindings' env') id)

name: nsBindList_global_bind_commute_lookup
pretty:
⊢ ALOOKUP locals fresh = NONE ⇒
  nsLookup (nsBindList locals (nsBind fresh value globals)) id =
  nsLookup (nsBind fresh value (nsBindList locals globals)) id

name: nsBindList_clauses
pretty: ⊢ nsBindList [] env = env ∧ nsBindList ((name,value)::bindings) env = nsBind name value (nsBindList bindings env)

name: nsBindList_append
pretty: ⊢ nsBindList (bindings ++ locals) env = nsBindList bindings (nsBindList locals env)

name: nsBind_nsEmpty
pretty: ⊢ ∀x y env. nsBind x y env ≠ nsEmpty

name: nsBind_11
pretty: ⊢ ∀x y n x' y' n'. nsBind x y n = nsBind x' y' n' ⇔ x = x' ∧ y = y' ∧ n = n'

name: nsAppend_to_nsBindList
pretty: ⊢ ∀l. nsAppend (alist_to_ns l) e = nsBindList l e

name: nsAppend_nsSing
pretty: ⊢ ∀n x e. nsAppend (nsSing n x) e = nsBind n x e

name: nsAppend_nsEmpty
pretty: ⊢ ∀env. nsAppend env nsEmpty = env ∧ nsAppend nsEmpty env = env

name: nsAppend_nsBind
pretty: ⊢ ∀k v e1 e2. nsAppend (nsBind k v e1) e2 = nsBind k v (nsAppend e1 e2)

name: nsAppend_assoc
pretty: ⊢ ∀e1 e2 e3. nsAppend e1 (nsAppend e2 e3) = nsAppend (nsAppend e1 e2) e3

name: nsAppend_alist_to_ns
pretty: ⊢ ∀al1 al2. nsAppend (alist_to_ns al1) (alist_to_ns al2) = alist_to_ns (al1 ++ al2)

name: nsAll_nsSing
pretty: ⊢ ∀R n v. nsAll R (nsSing n v) ⇔ R (Short n) v

pretty: ⊢ ∀P x v e. (x = NONE ∨ ∃n. x = SOME n ∧ P (Short n) v) ∧ nsAll P e ⇒ nsAll P (nsOptBind x v e)

pretty: ⊢ ∀f n P. nsAll P (nsMap f n) ⇔ nsAll (λx y. P x (f y)) n

name: nsAll_nsEmpty

name: alist_rel_restr_def

⊢ (∀R l1 l2. alist_rel_restr R l1 l2 [] ⇔ T) ∧

⊢ ∀src srcoff len d.
    copy_array (src,srcoff) len d =
    if srcoff < 0 ∨ len < 0 ∨ LENGTH src < Num (ABS (I (srcoff + len))) then NONE
    else
      (let
         copied = TAKE (Num (ABS (I len))) (DROP (Num (ABS (I srcoff))) src)
       in
         case d of
           NONE => SOME copied
         | SOME (dst,dstoff) =>
           if dstoff < 0 ∨ LENGTH dst < Num (ABS (I (dstoff + len))) then NONE
           else SOME (TAKE (Num (ABS (I dstoff))) dst ++ copied ++ DROP (Num (ABS (I (dstoff + len)))) dst))

name: full_evaluate_def
pretty:
⊢ (∀st env. evaluate st env [] = (st,Rval [])) ∧
  (∀st es env e2 e1.
     evaluate st env (e1::e2::es) =
     case evaluate st env [e1] of
       (st',Rval v1) =>
         (case evaluate st' env (e2::es) of
            (st'',Rval vs) => (st'',Rval (HD v1::vs))
          | (st'',Rerr v8) => (st'',Rerr v8))
     | (st',Rerr v10) => (st',Rerr v10)) ∧ (∀st l env. evaluate st env [Lit l] = (st,Rval [Litv l])) ∧
  (∀st env e.
     evaluate st env [Raise e] =
     case evaluate st env [e] of (st',Rval v) => (st',Rerr (Rraise (HD v))) | (st',Rerr v8) => (st',Rerr v8)) ∧
  (∀st pes env e.
     evaluate st env [Handle e pes] =
     case evaluate st env [e] of
       (st',Rval v7) => (st',Rval v7)
     | (st',Rerr (Rraise v)) =>
       if can_pmatch_all env.c st'.refs (MAP FST pes) v then evaluate_match st' env v pes v
       else (st',Rerr (Rabort Rtype_error))
     | (st',Rerr (Rabort v12)) => (st',Rerr (Rabort v12))) ∧
  (∀st es env cn.
     evaluate st env [Con cn es] =
     if do_con_check env.c cn (LENGTH es) then
       case evaluate st env (REVERSE es) of
         (st',Rval vs) =>
           (case build_conv env.c cn (REVERSE vs) of NONE => (st',Rerr (Rabort Rtype_error)) | SOME v => (st',Rval [v]))
       | (st',Rerr v8) => (st',Rerr v8)
     else (st,Rerr (Rabort Rtype_error))) ∧
  (∀st n env.
     evaluate st env [Var n] = case nsLookup env.v n of NONE => (st,Rerr (Rabort Rtype_error)) | SOME v => (st,Rval [v])) ∧
  (∀x st env e. evaluate st env [Fun x e] = (st,Rval [Closure env x e])) ∧
  (∀st op es env.
     evaluate st env [App op es] =
     case evaluate st env (REVERSE es) of
       (st',Rval vs) =>
         if op = Opapp then
           case do_opapp (REVERSE vs) of
             NONE => (st',Rerr (Rabort Rtype_error))
           | SOME (env',e) =>
             if st'.clock = 0 then (st',Rerr (Rabort Rtimeout_error)) else evaluate (dec_clock st') env' [e]
         else if op = ThunkOp ForceThunk then
           case dest_thunk (REVERSE vs) st'.refs of
             BadRef => (st',Rerr (Rabort Rtype_error))
           | NotThunk => (st',Rerr (Rabort Rtype_error))
           | IsThunk Evaluated v => (st',Rval [v])
           | IsThunk NotEvaluated v =>
             case do_opapp [v; Conv NONE []] of
               NONE => (st',Rerr (Rabort Rtype_error))
             | SOME (env',e) =>
               if st'.clock = 0 then (st',Rerr (Rabort Rtimeout_error))
               else
                 case evaluate (dec_clock st') env' [e] of
                   (st2,Rval vs2) =>
                     (case update_thunk (REVERSE vs) st2.refs vs2 of
                        NONE => (st2,Rerr (Rabort Rtype_error))
                      | SOME refs => (st2 with refs := refs,Rval vs2))
                 | (st2,Rerr e) => (st2,Rerr e)
         else if op = Eval then
           case do_eval_init (REVERSE vs) st'.eval_state of
             NONE =>
               (case do_eval_res (REVERSE vs) st' of
                  (st1,Rval (INL v)) => (st1,Rval [v])
                | (st1,Rval (INR (env1,decs))) =>
                  if st1.clock = 0 then (st1,Rerr (Rabort Rtimeout_error))
                  else
                    (case evaluate_decs (dec_clock st1) env1 decs of
                       (st2,Rval env2) =>
                         (case declare_env st2.eval_state (env2 +++ env1) of
                            NONE => (st2,Rerr (Rabort Rtype_error))
                          | SOME (x,es2) =>
                            (st2 with eval_state := reset_env_generation st'.eval_state es2,
                             Rval [Conv NONE [x; Litv (StrLit «»)]]))
                     | (st2,Rerr (Rraise v7)) =>
                       (st2 with eval_state := reset_env_generation st'.eval_state st2.eval_state,Rerr (Rraise v7))
                     | (st2,Rerr (Rabort a)) => (st2,Rerr (Rabort a)))
                | (st1,Rerr e) => (st1,Rerr e))
           | SOME es' => (st' with eval_state := SOME es',Rval [Conv NONE []])
         else if op = PtrEq then
           case REVERSE vs of
             [] => (st',Rerr (Rabort Rtype_error))
           | [v1] => (st',Rerr (Rabort Rtype_error))
           | [v1; v2] =>
             (case do_eq v1 v2 of
                Eq_val b =>
                  (st' with ptr_eq_oracle := st'.ptr_eq_oracle⦇0 ↦ shift_seq 1 (st'.ptr_eq_oracle 0)⦈,
                   Rval [Boolv (b ∧ st'.ptr_eq_oracle 0 0)])
              | Eq_type_error => (st',Rerr (Rabort Rtype_error)))
           | v1::v2::v12::v13 => (st',Rerr (Rabort Rtype_error))
         else
           (case do_app (st'.refs,st'.ffi) op (REVERSE vs) of
              NONE => (st',Rerr (Rabort Rtype_error))
            | SOME ((refs,ffi),r) => (st' with <|refs := refs; ffi := ffi|>,list_result r))
     | (st',Rerr v17) => (st',Rerr v17)) ∧
  (∀st lop env e2 e1.
     evaluate st env [Log lop e1 e2] =
     case evaluate st env [e1] of
       (st',Rval v1) =>
         (case do_log lop (HD v1) e2 of
            NONE => (st',Rerr (Rabort Rtype_error))
          | SOME (Exp e) => evaluate st' env [e]

     | (st',Rerr v9) => (st',Rerr v9)) ∧

         (case do_if (HD v) e2 e3 of NONE => (st',Rerr (Rabort Rtype_error)) | SOME e => evaluate st' env [e])
     | (st',Rerr v8) => (st',Rerr v8)) ∧
  (∀st pes env e.

     case evaluate st env [e] of

     | (st',Rerr v8) => (st',Rerr v8)) ∧
  (∀xo st env e2 e1.
     evaluate st env [Let xo e1 e2] =
     case evaluate st env [e1] of
       (st',Rval v) => evaluate st' (env with v := nsOptBind xo (HD v) env.v) [e2]
     | (st',Rerr v8) => (st',Rerr v8)) ∧
  (∀st funs env e.
     evaluate st env [Letrec funs e] =
     if ALL_DISTINCT (MAP (λ(x,y,z). x) funs) then evaluate st (env with v := build_rec_env funs env env.v) [e]
     else (st,Rerr (Rabort Rtype_error))) ∧ (∀t st env e. evaluate st env [Tannot e t] = evaluate st env [e]) ∧
  (∀st l env e. evaluate st env [Lannot e l] = evaluate st env [e]) ∧
  (∀st path env e.
     evaluate st env [Open path e] =
     case open_dec_env path env of
       NONE => (st,Rerr (Rabort Rtype_error))
     | SOME opened => evaluate st (opened +++ env) [e]) ∧
  (∀st sa env e.
     evaluate st env [Assert e sa] =
     case evaluate st env [e] of
       (st',Rval v) => if check_shape env.c sa (HD v) then (st',Rval v) else (st',Rerr (Rabort Rtype_error))
     | (st',Rerr err) => (st',Rerr err)) ∧
  (∀v st err_v env. evaluate_match st env v [] err_v = (st,Rerr (Rraise err_v))) ∧
  (∀v st pes p err_v env e.
     evaluate_match st env v ((p,e)::pes) err_v =
     if ALL_DISTINCT (pat_bindings p) then
       case pmatch env.c st.refs p v [] of
         No_match => evaluate_match st env v pes err_v
       | Match_type_error => (st,Rerr (Rabort Rtype_error))
       | Match env_v' => evaluate st (env with v := nsAppend (alist_to_ns env_v') env.v) [e]
     else (st,Rerr (Rabort Rtype_error))) ∧
  (∀st env. evaluate_decs st env [] = (st,Rval <|v := nsEmpty; c := nsEmpty|>)) ∧
  (∀st env ds d2 d1.
     evaluate_decs st env (d1::d2::ds) =
     case evaluate_decs st env [d1] of
       (st1,Rval env1) => (case evaluate_decs st1 (env1 +++ env) (d2::ds) of (st2,r) => (st2,combine_dec_result env1 r))
     | (st1,Rerr v7) => (st1,Rerr v7)) ∧
  (∀st p locs env e.
     evaluate_decs st env [Dlet locs p e] =
     if ALL_DISTINCT (pat_bindings p) ∧ check_exp_constructors env.c e then
       case evaluate st env [e] of
         (st',Rval v) =>
           (st',
            case pmatch env.c st'.refs p (HD v) [] of
              No_match => Rerr (Rraise bind_exn_v)
            | Match_type_error => Rerr (Rabort Rtype_error)
            | Match new_vals => Rval <|v := alist_to_ns new_vals; c := nsEmpty|>)
       | (st',Rerr err) => (st',Rerr err)
     else (st,Rerr (Rabort Rtype_error))) ∧
  (∀st locs funs env.
     evaluate_decs st env [Dletrec locs funs] =
     (st,
      if ALL_DISTINCT (MAP (λ(x,y,z). x) funs) ∧ EVERY (λ(f,n,e). check_exp_constructors env.c e) funs then
        Rval <|v := build_rec_env funs env nsEmpty; c := nsEmpty|>
      else Rerr (Rabort Rtype_error))) ∧
  (∀tds st locs env.
     evaluate_decs st env [Dtype locs tds] =
     if EVERY check_dup_ctors tds then
       (st with next_type_stamp := st.next_type_stamp + LENGTH tds,
        Rval <|v := nsEmpty; c := build_tdefs st.next_type_stamp tds|>)
     else (st,Rerr (Rabort Rtype_error))) ∧
  (∀tvs tn t st locs env. evaluate_decs st env [Dtabbrev locs tvs tn t] = (st,Rval <|v := nsEmpty; c := nsEmpty|>)) ∧
  (∀st n env.
     evaluate_decs st env [Denv n] =
     case declare_env st.eval_state env of
       NONE => (st,Rerr (Rabort Rtype_error))
     | SOME (x,es') => (st with eval_state := es',Rval <|v := nsSing n x; c := nsEmpty|>)) ∧
  (∀ts st locs env cn.
     evaluate_decs st env [Dexn locs cn ts] =

     case evaluate_decs st env ds of

  ∀st lds env ds.

name: evaluate_def
pretty:
⊢ (∀st env. evaluate st env [] = (st,Rval [])) ∧

     evaluate st env (e1::e2::es) =
     case evaluate st env [e1] of
       (st',Rval v1) =>
         (case evaluate st' env (e2::es) of

  (∀st env e.
     evaluate st env [Raise e] =
     case evaluate st env [e] of (st',Rval v) => (st',Rerr (Rraise (HD v))) | (st',Rerr v8) => (st',Rerr v8)) ∧
  (∀st pes env e.
     evaluate st env [Handle e pes] =

       if can_pmatch_all env.c st'.refs (MAP FST pes) v then evaluate_match st' env v pes v
       else (st',Rerr (Rabort Rtype_error))
     | (st',Rerr (Rabort v12)) => (st',Rerr (Rabort v12))) ∧
  (∀st es env cn.
     evaluate st env [Con cn es] =
     if do_con_check env.c cn (LENGTH es) then
       case evaluate st env (REVERSE es) of
         (st',Rval vs) =>
           (case build_conv env.c cn (REVERSE vs) of NONE => (st',Rerr (Rabort Rtype_error)) | SOME v => (st',Rval [v]))
       | (st',Rerr v8) => (st',Rerr v8)
     else (st,Rerr (Rabort Rtype_error))) ∧
  (∀st n env.
     evaluate st env [Var n] = case nsLookup env.v n of NONE => (st,Rerr (Rabort Rtype_error)) | SOME v => (st,Rval [v])) ∧
  (∀x st env e. evaluate st env [Fun x e] = (st,Rval [Closure env x e])) ∧
  (∀st op es env.
     evaluate st env [App op es] =
     case evaluate st env (REVERSE es) of
       (st',Rval vs) =>
         if op = Opapp then
           case do_opapp (REVERSE vs) of
             NONE => (st',Rerr (Rabort Rtype_error))
           | SOME (env',e) =>
             if st'.clock = 0 then (st',Rerr (Rabort Rtimeout_error)) else evaluate (dec_clock st') env' [e]
         else if op = ThunkOp ForceThunk then
           case dest_thunk (REVERSE vs) st'.refs of
             BadRef => (st',Rerr (Rabort Rtype_error))
           | NotThunk => (st',Rerr (Rabort Rtype_error))
           | IsThunk Evaluated v => (st',Rval [v])
           | IsThunk NotEvaluated v =>
             case do_opapp [v; Conv NONE []] of
               NONE => (st',Rerr (Rabort Rtype_error))
             | SOME (env',e) =>
               if st'.clock = 0 then (st',Rerr (Rabort Rtimeout_error))

                 case evaluate (dec_clock st') env' [e] of
                   (st2,Rval vs2) =>

                      | SOME refs => (st2 with refs := refs,Rval vs2))
                 | (st2,Rerr e) => (st2,Rerr e)
         else if op = Eval then
           case do_eval_init (REVERSE vs) st'.eval_state of
             NONE =>
               (case do_eval_res (REVERSE vs) st' of
                  (st1,Rval (INL v)) => (st1,Rval [v])
                | (st1,Rval (INR (env1,decs))) =>
                  if st1.clock = 0 then (st1,Rerr (Rabort Rtimeout_error))
                  else
                    (case evaluate_decs (dec_clock st1) env1 decs of
                       (st2,Rval env2) =>
                         (case declare_env st2.eval_state (env2 +++ env1) of
                            NONE => (st2,Rerr (Rabort Rtype_error))
                          | SOME (x,es2) =>
                            (st2 with eval_state := reset_env_generation st'.eval_state es2,
                             Rval [Conv NONE [x; Litv (StrLit «»)]]))
                     | (st2,Rerr (Rraise v7)) =>
                       (st2 with eval_state := reset_env_generation st'.eval_state st2.eval_state,Rerr (Rraise v7))
                     | (st2,Rerr (Rabort a)) => (st2,Rerr (Rabort a)))
                | (st1,Rerr e) => (st1,Rerr e))
           | SOME es' => (st' with eval_state := SOME es',Rval [Conv NONE []])
         else if op = PtrEq then
           case REVERSE vs of
             [] => (st',Rerr (Rabort Rtype_error))
           | [v1] => (st',Rerr (Rabort Rtype_error))
           | [v1; v2] =>

           | v1::v2::v12::v13 => (st',Rerr (Rabort Rtype_error))
         else

     | (st',Rerr v17) => (st',Rerr v17)) ∧
  (∀st lop env e2 e1.

     | (st',Rerr v8) => (st',Rerr v8)) ∧
  (∀st pes env e.
     evaluate st env [Mat e pes] =

     | (st',Rerr v8) => (st',Rerr v8)) ∧
  (∀xo st env e2 e1.

     | (st',Rerr v8) => (st',Rerr v8)) ∧
  (∀st funs env e.
     evaluate st env [Letrec funs e] =

  (∀st l env e. evaluate st env [Lannot e l] = evaluate st env [e]) ∧
  (∀st path env e.

       LIST_REL (type_v a0 a1 a2) vs (MAP (type_subst (FEMPTY |++ REVERSE (ZIP (tvs',ts')))) ts) ∧

    (∃env tenv tenvE n e t1 t2.

       nsAll2 (type_ctor a1) env.c tenv.c ∧ nsAll2 (λi v (tvs,t). type_v tvs a1 a2 v t) env.v (add_tenvE tenvE tenv.v) ∧

       nsAll2 (type_ctor a1) env.c tenv.c ∧ nsAll2 (λi v (tvs,t). type_v tvs a1 a2 v t) env.v (add_tenvE tenvE tenv.v) ∧
       type_funs tenv (bind_var_list 0 bindings (bind_tvar a0 tenvE)) funs bindings ∧ ALOOKUP bindings n = SOME a4 ∧
       ALL_DISTINCT (MAP FST funs) ∧ MEM n (MAP FST funs)) ∨
    (∃n t. a3 = Loc T n ∧ a4 = Tref t ∧ check_freevars 0 [] t ∧ FLOOKUP a2 n = SOME (Ref_t t)) ∨

    if FST nt ≠ mkNT nOpID then NONE
    else
      case subs of
        [] => NONE
      | [Lf (TK tk,v17)] =>
        OPTION_CHOICE
          (OPTION_CHOICE
             (OPTION_CHOICE
                (OPTION_BIND (destAlphaT tk)
                   (λs. ifM (isConstructor (explode s)) (SOME (Con (SOME (Short s)) [])) (SOME (Var (Short s)))))
                (OPTION_BIND (destSymbolT tk)
                   (λs. ifM (isSymbolicConstructor (explode s)) (SOME (Con (SOME (Short s)) [])) (SOME (Var (Short s))))))
             (OPTION_BIND (destLongidT tk)
                (λ(path,s).
                   ifM (isConstructor (explode s)) (SOME (Con (SOME (Long_Short path s)) []))
                     (SOME (Var (Long_Short path s))))))
          (if tk = StarT then
             ifM (isSymbolicConstructor "*") (SOME (Con (SOME (Short «*»)) [])) (SOME (Var (Short «*»)))

name: ptree_Op_def
pretty:
⊢ (∀v0. ptree_Op (Lf v0) = NONE) ∧
  ∀nt subs.
    ptree_Op (Nd nt subs) =
    if FST nt = mkNT nMultOps then
      if tokcheckl subs [StarT] then SOME (Short «*»)
      else if tokcheckl subs [AlphaT «mod»] then SOME (Short «mod»)
      else if tokcheckl subs [AlphaT «div»] then SOME (Short «div»)
      else singleSymP (validMultSym ∘ explode) subs
    else if FST nt = mkNT nAddOps then singleSymP (validAddSym ∘ explode) subs
    else if FST nt = mkNT nListOps then singleSymP (validListSym ∘ explode) subs
    else if FST nt = mkNT nRelOps then
      OPTION_CHOICE (singleSymP (validRelSym ∘ explode) subs)
        (OPTION_IGNORE_BIND (OPTION_GUARD (tokcheckl subs [EqualsT])) (SOME (Short «=»)))
    else if FST nt = mkNT nCompOps then
      if tokcheckl subs [SymbolT «:=»] then SOME (Short «:=»)
      else if tokcheckl subs [AlphaT «o»] then SOME (Short «o»)
      else NONE
    else NONE

⊢ (∀v0 ent. ptree_Expr ent (Lf v0) = NONE) ∧
  (∀subs nt loc ent.
     ptree_Expr ent (Nd (nt,loc) subs) =
     OPTION_BIND
       (if mkNT ent = nt then
          if nt = mkNT nEbase then
            (case subs of
               [] => NONE
             | [lpart] =>
               OPTION_CHOICE
                 (OPTION_CHOICE
                    (OPTION_CHOICE (ptree_Eliteral lpart) (OPTION_BIND (ptree_FQV lpart) (λs. SOME (Var s))))
                    (OPTION_BIND (ptree_ConstructorName lpart) (λcname. SOME (Con (SOME cname) []))))
                 (ptree_Expr nEtuple lpart)
             | [lpart; pt] =>
               if tokcheckl [lpart; pt] [LparT; RparT] then SOME (Con NONE [])
               else if tokcheckl [lpart; pt] [LbrackT; RbrackT] then SOME (Con (SOME (Short «[]»)) [])
               else if tokcheck lpart OpT then ptree_OpID pt
               else NONE
             | [lpart; pt; rpart] =>
               if tokcheck lpart LparT then
                 OPTION_IGNORE_BIND (OPTION_GUARD (tokcheck rpart RparT))
                   (OPTION_BIND (ptree_Eseq pt) (λeseq. Eseq_encode eseq))
               else
                 OPTION_IGNORE_BIND (OPTION_GUARD (tokcheckl [lpart; rpart] [LbrackT; RbrackT]))
                   (OPTION_BIND (ptree_Exprlist nElist1 pt)
                      (λelist.
                         SOME (FOLDR (λe acc. Con (SOME (Short «::»)) [e; acc]) (Con (SOME (Short «[]»)) []) elist)))
             | [lpart; pt; rpart; ept] => NONE

               OPTION_IGNORE_BIND (OPTION_GUARD (tokcheckl [lpart; rpart; endt] [LetT; InT; EndT]))
                 (OPTION_BIND (ptree_LetDecs pt)
                    (λletdecs.

                         (λeseq. OPTION_BIND (Eseq_encode eseq) (λe. SOME (FOLDR let_dec_exp e letdecs)))))
             | lpart::pt::rpart::ept::endt::v22::v23 => NONE)
          else if nt = mkNT nEapp then
            (case subs of
               [] => NONE
             | [t1] => ptree_Expr nEbase t1
             | [t1; t2] =>
               OPTION_BIND (ptree_Expr nEapp t1) (λa1. OPTION_BIND (ptree_Expr nEbase t2) (λa2. SOME (mkAst_App a1 a2)))

          else if nt = mkNT nEtuple then

            (case subs of

             | [t1; opt; t2] =>

                 (λa1.

          (OPTION_BIND (ptree_StructName sname_pt)

name: simple_val_rel_def
pretty:
⊢ ∀vr.
    simple_val_rel vr ⇔
    ∀x y.
      vr x y ⇔
      case y of
        Litv v14 => x = y
      | Conv stmp ys => ∃xs. x = Conv stmp xs ∧ LIST_REL vr xs ys
      | Closure v17 v18 v19 => is_clos x
      | Recclosure v20 v21 v22 => is_clos x
      | Loc v23 v24 => x = y
      | Vectorv ys' => ∃xs. x = Vectorv xs ∧ LIST_REL vr xs ys'
      | Env envy id => ∃envx. x = Env envx id

name: simple_val_rel_cases

  (∀x ys. vr x (Vectorv ys) ⇔ ∃xs. x = Vectorv xs ∧ LIST_REL vr xs ys) ∧ (∀x e n b. vr x (Closure e n b) ⇔ is_clos x) ∧

name: shape_val_rel_index_witness_length

name: shape_val_rel_do_eq

name: shape_val_rel_do_compare

name: shape_val_rel_def
pretty:
⊢ ∀vr.
    shape_val_rel vr ⇔
    (∀l y. vr (Litv l) y ⇔ y = Litv l) ∧ (∀b n y. vr (Loc b n) y ⇔ y = Loc b n) ∧
    (∀stmp xs y. vr (Conv stmp xs) y ⇔ ∃ys. y = Conv stmp ys ∧ LIST_REL vr xs ys) ∧
    (∀xs y. vr (Vectorv xs) y ⇔ ∃ys. y = Vectorv ys ∧ LIST_REL vr xs ys) ∧
    (∀env n e y. vr (Closure env n e) y ⇒ is_clos y) ∧ (∀env fs n y. vr (Recclosure env fs n) y ⇒ is_clos y) ∧
    ∀env id y. vr (Env env id) y ⇒ ∃env'. y = Env env' id

  | Conv stmp xs => ∃ys. y = Conv stmp ys ∧ LIST_REL vr xs ys
  | Closure v17 v18 v19 => is_clos y
  | Recclosure v20 v21 v22 => is_clos y
  | Loc v23 v24 => y = x
  | Vectorv xs' => ∃ys. y = Vectorv ys ∧ LIST_REL vr xs' ys

name: result_rel_Rval
pretty: ⊢ result_rel R1 R2 (Rval v) r ⇔ ∃v'. r = Rval v' ∧ R1 v v'

      (∀v4 v5 v13 v18. P v4 v5 (Rval v13) (Rerr v18)) ∧ (∀v4 v5 v14 v21. P v4 v5 (Rerr v14) (Rval v21)) ⇒

⊢ (∀ns st pat v env m ns'.

     (pmatch ns st pat v env = Match m ⇒ pmatch (nsAppend ns ns') st pat v env = Match m)) ∧
  ∀ns st pats vs env m ns'.
    (pmatch_list ns st pats vs env = No_match ⇒ pmatch_list (nsAppend ns ns') st pats vs env = No_match) ∧
    (pmatch_list ns st pats vs env = Match m ⇒ pmatch_list (nsAppend ns ns') st pats vs env = Match m)

name: pmatch_extend
pretty:
⊢ (∀cenv s p v env env' env''.
     pmatch cenv s p v env = Match env' ⇒ ∃env''. env' = env'' ++ env ∧ MAP FST env'' = pat_bindings p) ∧
  ∀cenv s ps vs env env' env''.
    pmatch_list cenv s ps vs env = Match env' ⇒ ∃env''. env' = env'' ++ env ∧ MAP FST env'' = pats_bindings ps

name: pmatch_append
pretty:
⊢ (∀cenv st p v env env' env''.
     pmatch cenv st p v env = Match env' ⇒ pmatch cenv st p v (env ++ env'') = Match (env' ++ env'')) ∧
  ∀cenv st ps v env env' env''.
    pmatch_list cenv st ps v env = Match env' ⇒ pmatch_list cenv st ps v (env ++ env'') = Match (env' ++ env'')

name: pmatch_acc
pretty:
⊢ (∀envc store p v env env' env2.
     (pmatch envc store p v env = Match env' ⇔ pmatch envc store p v (env ++ env2) = Match (env' ++ env2)) ∧
     (pmatch envc store p v env = No_match ⇔ pmatch envc store p v (env ++ env2) = No_match) ∧
     (pmatch envc store p v env = Match_type_error ⇔ pmatch envc store p v (env ++ env2) = Match_type_error)) ∧
  ∀envc store ps vs env env' env2.
    (pmatch_list envc store ps vs env = Match env' ⇔ pmatch_list envc store ps vs (env ++ env2) = Match (env' ++ env2)) ∧
    (pmatch_list envc store ps vs env = No_match ⇔ pmatch_list envc store ps vs (env ++ env2) = No_match) ∧
    (pmatch_list envc store ps vs env = Match_type_error ⇔ pmatch_list envc store ps vs (env ++ env2) = Match_type_error)

         (deBruijn_subst (num_tvs tenvE1) targs' t)) ∧

       EVERY (check_freevars tvs []) targs ∧ tenvE = db_merge tenvE1 (bind_tvar (LENGTH targs) tenvE2) ∧

    tveLookup x tvs (bind_var_list tvs' bindings tenvE) =
    case ALOOKUP bindings x of NONE => tveLookup x tvs tenvE | SOME t => SOME (tvs',deBruijn_inc tvs' tvs t)

name: tveLookup_add_inc
pretty:
⊢ ∀x inc tenv tvs t inc2.
    tveLookup x inc tenv = SOME (tvs,t) ⇒ tveLookup x (inc2 + inc) tenv = SOME (tvs,deBruijn_inc tvs inc2 t)

name: tenv_val_ok_nsEmpty
pretty: ⊢ tenv_val_ok nsEmpty

name: tenv_val_ok_add_tenvE
pretty: ⊢ ∀tenvE tenvV. num_tvs tenvE = 0 ∧ tenv_val_exp_ok tenvE ∧ tenv_val_ok tenvV ⇒ tenv_val_ok (add_tenvE tenvE tenvV)

name: tenv_val_exp_ok_tveMask
pretty: ⊢ ∀tenvE. tenv_val_exp_ok tenvE ⇒ tenv_val_exp_ok (tveMask hidden tenvE)

name: tenv_val_exp_ok_db_merge
pretty: ⊢ ∀e1 e2. tenv_val_exp_ok (db_merge e1 e2) ⇒ tenv_val_exp_ok e2

name: tenv_val_exp_ok_bvl_tvs
pretty:
⊢ ∀funs tenv env tvs bindings tenvE.
    type_funs tenv (bind_var_list 0 bindings (bind_tvar tvs tenvE)) funs env ∧ tenv_val_exp_ok tenvE ⇒
    tenv_val_exp_ok (bind_var_list tvs env tenvE)

name: tenv_val_exp_ok_bvl_funs
pretty:
⊢ ∀funs env tenv bindings tenv_val tenvE.
    type_funs tenv (bind_var_list 0 bindings tenvE) funs env ∧ tenv_val_exp_ok tenvE ⇒
    tenv_val_exp_ok (bind_var_list 0 env tenvE)

name: tenv_val_exp_ok_bvl
pretty:
⊢ ∀tenvE env.
    tenv_val_exp_ok tenvE ∧ EVERY (check_freevars (num_tvs tenvE) []) (MAP SND env) ⇒
    tenv_val_exp_ok (bind_var_list 0 env tenvE)

name: tenv_ok_open_tenv
pretty: ⊢ ∀tenv path opened. tenv_ok tenv ∧ open_tenv path tenv = SOME opened ⇒ tenv_ok opened

name: tenv_ok_empty
pretty: ⊢ tenv_ok <|v := nsEmpty; c := nsEmpty; t := nsEmpty|>

name: tenv_ctor_ok_nsEmpty
pretty: ⊢ tenv_ctor_ok nsEmpty

name: tenv_ctor_ok_merge
pretty: ⊢ ∀tenvC1 tenvC2. tenv_ctor_ok tenvC1 ∧ tenv_ctor_ok tenvC2 ⇒ tenv_ctor_ok (nsAppend tenvC1 tenvC2)

name: tenv_ctor_ok_lookup
pretty: ⊢ ∀tenvC cn tvs ts tn. tenv_ctor_ok tenvC ∧ nsLookup tenvC cn = SOME (tvs,ts,tn) ⇒ EVERY (check_freevars 0 tvs) ts

name: tenv_abbrev_ok_nsEmpty
pretty: ⊢ tenv_abbrev_ok nsEmpty

name: tenv_abbrev_ok_merge
pretty: ⊢ ∀tenvT1 tenvT2. tenv_abbrev_ok tenvT1 ∧ tenv_abbrev_ok tenvT2 ⇒ tenv_abbrev_ok (nsAppend tenvT1 tenvT2)

name: tenv_abbrev_ok_lookup
pretty: ⊢ ∀tenvT tn tvs t. tenv_abbrev_ok tenvT ∧ nsLookup tenvT tn = SOME (tvs,t) ⇒ check_freevars 0 tvs t

name: subst_inc_cancel
pretty:
⊢ (∀t ts inc. deBruijn_subst 0 ts (deBruijn_inc 0 (inc + LENGTH ts) t) = deBruijn_inc 0 inc t) ∧
  ∀ts' ts inc. MAP (deBruijn_subst 0 ts) (MAP (deBruijn_inc 0 (inc + LENGTH ts)) ts') = MAP (deBruijn_inc 0 inc) ts'

name: num_tvs_deBruijn_subst_tenvE
pretty: ⊢ ∀targs tenvE. num_tvs (deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs tenvE) = num_tvs tenvE

name: num_tvs_db_merge
pretty: ⊢ ∀e1 e2. num_tvs (db_merge e1 e2) = num_tvs e1 + num_tvs e2

name: num_tvs_bind_var_list
pretty: ⊢ ∀tvs env tenvE. num_tvs (bind_var_list tvs env tenvE) = num_tvs tenvE

name: nsMap_build_ctor_tenv
pretty:
⊢ ∀ga g h tenvT tds ids.
    LENGTH tds = LENGTH ids ∧
    (∀x. MEM x (MAP SND (FLAT (MAP (SND ∘ SND) tds))) ⇒
         MAP (type_name_subst tenvT) (ga x) = g (MAP (type_name_subst tenvT) x)) ⇒
    nsMap (λ(tvs,ts,tid). (tvs,g ts,h tid)) (build_ctor_tenv tenvT tds ids) =
    build_ctor_tenv tenvT (MAP (I ## I ## MAP (I ## ga)) tds) (MAP h ids)

name: nsLookup_add_tenvE3
pretty:
⊢ ∀tenvE tenvV n t tvs2 mn.
    nsLookup tenvV (Long mn n) = SOME (tvs2,t) ⇒ nsLookup (add_tenvE tenvE tenvV) (Long mn n) = SOME (tvs2,t)

name: nsLookup_add_tenvE2
pretty:
⊢ ∀tenvE tenvV n tvs t tvs2.
    tveLookup n tvs tenvE = NONE ∧ nsLookup tenvV (Short n) = SOME (tvs2,t) ⇒
    nsLookup (add_tenvE tenvE tenvV) (Short n) = SOME (tvs2,t)

name: nsLookup_add_tenvE1
pretty:
⊢ ∀tenvE tenvV n tvs t tvs2.
    check_freevars tvs2 [] t ∧ tveLookup n tvs tenvE = SOME (tvs2,t) ⇒
    nsLookup (add_tenvE tenvE tenvV) (Short n) = SOME (tvs2,t)

name: nil_deBruijn_subst
pretty: ⊢ ∀skip tvs t. check_freevars skip [] t ⇒ deBruijn_subst skip tvs t = t

name: nil_deBruijn_inc
pretty: ⊢ ∀skip tvs t. check_freevars skip [] t ∨ check_freevars skip [] (deBruijn_inc skip tvs t) ⇒ deBruijn_inc skip tvs t = t

name: mem_type_def_to_ctMap
pretty:
⊢ ∀tenvT next tds ids stamp x.
    MEM (stamp,x) (type_def_to_ctMap tenvT next tds ids) ∧ LENGTH tds = LENGTH ids ⇒
    ∃cn i pos. stamp = TypeStamp cn i pos ∧ next ≤ i ∧ i < next + LENGTH tds

name: extend_dec_tenv_ok
pretty: ⊢ ∀tenv tenv'. tenv_ok tenv ∧ tenv_ok tenv' ⇒ tenv_ok (extend_dec_tenv tenv tenv')

name: extend_dec_tenv_assoc
pretty:
⊢ ∀tenv1 tenv2 tenv3.
    extend_dec_tenv tenv1 (extend_dec_tenv tenv2 tenv3) = extend_dec_tenv (extend_dec_tenv tenv1 tenv2) tenv3

name: deBruijn_subst_tenvE_def
pretty:
⊢ (∀targs. deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs Empty = Empty) ∧
  (∀targs tvs env. deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs (Bind_tvar tvs env) = Bind_tvar tvs (deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs env)) ∧
  ∀targs x tvs t env.
    deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs (Bind_name x tvs t env) =
    Bind_name x tvs (deBruijn_subst (tvs + num_tvs env) (MAP (deBruijn_inc 0 (tvs + num_tvs env)) targs) t)
      (deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs env)

name: deBruijn_subst_t_of
pretty: ⊢ deBruijn_subst skip targs (t_of ty) = t_of ty

name: deBruijn_subst_id
pretty:
⊢ (∀t n. check_freevars n [] t ⇒ deBruijn_subst 0 (MAP Tvar_db (COUNT_LIST n)) t = t) ∧
  ∀ts n. EVERY (check_freevars n []) ts ⇒ MAP (deBruijn_subst 0 (MAP Tvar_db (COUNT_LIST n))) ts = ts

name: deBruijn_subst_freevars
pretty:
⊢ ∀skip targs t tvs.
    skip = 0 ∧ EVERY (check_freevars tvs []) targs ∧ check_freevars (LENGTH targs) [] t ⇒
    check_freevars tvs [] (deBruijn_subst skip targs t)

name: deBruijn_subst_E_bvl
pretty:
⊢ ∀tenv1 tenv2 tvs.
    deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs (bind_var_list tvs tenv1 tenv2) =
    bind_var_list tvs
      (MAP (λ(x,t). (x,deBruijn_subst (tvs + num_tvs tenv2) (MAP (deBruijn_inc 0 (tvs + num_tvs tenv2)) targs) t)) tenv1)
      (deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs tenv2)

name: deBruijn_subst_check_freevars2
pretty:
⊢ ∀tvs tvs' t ts n tvs''.
    check_freevars (LENGTH ts) tvs' t ∧ EVERY (check_freevars tvs tvs') ts ⇒
    check_freevars tvs tvs' (deBruijn_subst 0 ts t)

name: deBruijn_subst_check_freevars
pretty:
⊢ ∀tvs tvs' t ts n.
    check_freevars tvs tvs' t ∧ EVERY (check_freevars tvs tvs') ts ⇒ check_freevars tvs tvs' (deBruijn_subst 0 ts t)

name: deBruijn_subst2
pretty:
⊢ (∀t sk targs targs' tvs'.
     check_freevars (LENGTH targs) [] t ⇒
     deBruijn_subst sk (MAP (deBruijn_inc 0 sk) targs') (deBruijn_subst 0 targs t) =
     deBruijn_subst 0 (MAP (deBruijn_subst sk (MAP (deBruijn_inc 0 sk) targs')) targs) t) ∧
  ∀ts sk targs targs' tvs'.
    EVERY (check_freevars (LENGTH targs) []) ts ⇒
    MAP (deBruijn_subst sk (MAP (deBruijn_inc 0 sk) targs')) (MAP (deBruijn_subst 0 targs) ts) =
    MAP (deBruijn_subst 0 (MAP (deBruijn_subst sk (MAP (deBruijn_inc 0 sk) targs')) targs)) ts

name: deBruijn_inc_deBruijn_inc
pretty: ⊢ ∀sk i2 t i1. deBruijn_inc sk i1 (deBruijn_inc sk i2 t) = deBruijn_inc sk (i1 + i2) t

name: deBruijn_inc0
pretty: ⊢ (∀t sk. deBruijn_inc sk 0 t = t) ∧ ∀ts sk. MAP (deBruijn_inc sk 0) ts = ts

name: db_merge_def
pretty:
⊢ (∀e. db_merge Empty e = e) ∧ (∀tvs e1 e2. db_merge (Bind_tvar tvs e1) e2 = Bind_tvar tvs (db_merge e1 e2)) ∧
  ∀x tvs t e1 e2. db_merge (Bind_name x tvs t e1) e2 = Bind_name x tvs t (db_merge e1 e2)

name: db_merge_bvl
pretty:
⊢ ∀tenv1 tenv2 tenv3 tvs.
    db_merge (bind_var_list tvs tenv1 tenv2) tenv3 = bind_var_list tvs tenv1 (db_merge tenv2 tenv3)

name: ctMap_ok_type_defs
pretty:
⊢ ∀tenvT next tds tids.
    ALL_DISTINCT tids ∧ DISJOINT (set tids) (set prim_type_nums) ∧ LENGTH tds = LENGTH tids ∧
    check_ctor_tenv tenvT tds ∧ tenv_abbrev_ok tenvT ⇒
    ctMap_ok (FEMPTY |++ REVERSE (type_def_to_ctMap tenvT next tds tids))

name: ctMap_ok_merge_imp
pretty:
⊢ ∀ctMap1 ctMap2.
    DISJOINT (FRANGE ((SND ∘ SND) o_f ctMap1)) (FRANGE ((SND ∘ SND) o_f ctMap2)) ∧ ctMap_ok ctMap1 ∧ ctMap_ok ctMap2 ⇒
    ctMap_ok (ctMap1 ⊌ ctMap2)

name: ctMap_ok_lookup
pretty: ⊢ ∀ctMap cn tvs ts ti tn. ctMap_ok ctMap ∧ FLOOKUP ctMap tn = SOME (tvs,ts,ti) ⇒ EVERY (check_freevars 0 tvs) ts

name: check_freevars_type_name_subst
pretty:
⊢ ∀tvs t dbmax tenvT.
    tenv_abbrev_ok tenvT ∧ check_type_names tenvT t ∧ check_freevars_ast tvs t ⇒
    check_freevars dbmax tvs (type_name_subst tenvT t)

name: check_freevars_subst_single
pretty:
⊢ ∀dbmax tvs t tvs' ts.
    LENGTH tvs = LENGTH ts ∧ check_freevars dbmax tvs t ∧ EVERY (check_freevars dbmax tvs') ts ⇒
    check_freevars dbmax tvs' (type_subst (alist_to_fmap (ZIP (tvs,ts))) t)

name: check_freevars_subst_list
pretty:
⊢ ∀dbmax tvs tvs' ts ts'.
    LENGTH tvs = LENGTH ts ∧ EVERY (check_freevars dbmax tvs) ts' ∧ EVERY (check_freevars dbmax tvs') ts ⇒
    EVERY (check_freevars dbmax tvs') (MAP (type_subst (alist_to_fmap (ZIP (tvs,ts)))) ts')

name: check_freevars_subst_inc
pretty:
⊢ ∀tvs tvs2 t.
    check_freevars tvs tvs2 t ⇒
    ∀tvs' targs tvs1.
      tvs = LENGTH targs + tvs' ∧ EVERY (check_freevars (tvs1 + tvs') tvs2) targs ⇒
      check_freevars (tvs1 + tvs') tvs2 (deBruijn_subst 0 targs (deBruijn_inc (LENGTH targs) tvs1 t))

name: check_freevars_subst
pretty:
⊢ ∀tvs tvs2 t.
    check_freevars tvs tvs2 t ⇒
    ∀tvs' targs tvs1.
      tvs = LENGTH targs + tvs' ∧ EVERY (check_freevars (tvs1 + tvs') tvs2) targs ⇒
      check_freevars (tvs1 + tvs') tvs2 (deBruijn_subst 0 targs t)

name: check_freevars_add
pretty: ⊢ ∀tvs tvs' t. check_freevars tvs tvs' t ⇒ ∀tvs''. tvs'' ≥ tvs ⇒ check_freevars tvs'' tvs' t

name: check_ctor_tenv_ok
pretty:
⊢ ∀tenvT tds tis.
    LENGTH tds = LENGTH tis ∧ check_ctor_tenv tenvT tds ∧ tenv_abbrev_ok tenvT ⇒
    tenv_ctor_ok (build_ctor_tenv tenvT tds tis)

name: check_ctor_tenv_EVERY
pretty:
⊢ ∀tenvT tds.
    check_ctor_tenv tenvT tds ⇔
    EVERY check_dup_ctors tds ∧ EVERY (ALL_DISTINCT ∘ FST) tds ∧
    EVERY
      (λ(tvs,tn,ctors). EVERY (λ(cn,ts). EVERY (check_freevars_ast tvs) ts ∧ EVERY (check_type_names tenvT) ts) ctors)
      tds ∧ ALL_DISTINCT (MAP (FST ∘ SND) tds)

name: check_ctor_tenv_change_tenvT
pretty:
⊢ ∀tenvT1 env tenvT2.
    EVERY (λ(cn,ts). EVERY (check_type_names tenvT1) ts ⇒ EVERY (check_type_names tenvT2) ts)
      (FLAT (MAP (SND ∘ SND) env)) ∧ check_ctor_tenv tenvT1 env ⇒
    check_ctor_tenv tenvT2 env

name: bind_var_list_append
pretty: ⊢ ∀n te1 te2 te3. bind_var_list n (te1 ++ te2) te3 = bind_var_list n te1 (bind_var_list n te2 te3)

name: bind_tvar_rewrites
pretty:
⊢ (∀tvs e1 e2. db_merge (bind_tvar tvs e1) e2 = bind_tvar tvs (db_merge e1 e2)) ∧
  (∀tvs e. num_tvs (bind_tvar tvs e) = tvs + num_tvs e) ∧ (∀tvs e. num_tvs (Bind_tvar tvs e) = tvs + num_tvs e) ∧
  (∀tvs n t e. num_tvs (Bind_name n tvs t e) = num_tvs e) ∧ (∀tvs e. num_tvs Empty = 0) ∧
  (∀n inc tvs e. tveLookup n inc (bind_tvar tvs e) = tveLookup n (inc + tvs) e) ∧
  (∀tvs e. tenv_val_exp_ok (bind_tvar tvs e) ⇔ tenv_val_exp_ok e) ∧
  ∀targs tvs e. deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs (bind_tvar tvs e) = bind_tvar tvs (deBruijn_subst_tenvE targs e)

name: bind_tvar0
pretty: ⊢ ∀x. bind_tvar 0 x = x

name: add_tenvE_nsAppend
pretty: ⊢ ∀tenvE tenvV. nsAppend (add_tenvE tenvE nsEmpty) tenvV = add_tenvE tenvE tenvV

name: add_tenvE_bvl
pretty:
⊢ ∀n bindings tenvE tenvV.
    add_tenvE (bind_var_list n bindings tenvE) tenvV =
    nsBindList (MAP (λ(x,t). (x,n,t)) bindings) (add_tenvE tenvE tenvV)

name: weakS_refl
pretty: ⊢ ∀tenvS. weakS tenvS tenvS

name: weakS_def
pretty: ⊢ ∀tenvS tenvS'. weakS tenvS tenvS' ⇔ tenvS' ⊑ tenvS

name: weakS_bind
pretty: ⊢ ∀l t tenvS. FLOOKUP tenvS l = NONE ⇒ weakS tenvS⟨l ↦ t⟩ tenvS

name: weakCT_trans
pretty: ⊢ weakCT C1 C2 ∧ weakCT C2 C3 ⇒ weakCT C1 C3

name: weakCT_refl
pretty: ⊢ ∀ctMap. weakCT ctMap ctMap

name: weakCT_def
pretty: ⊢ ∀cenv_impl cenv_spec. weakCT cenv_impl cenv_spec ⇔ cenv_spec ⊑ cenv_impl

name: weakCT2
pretty: ⊢ ∀ctMap ctMap'. weakCT (ctMap' ⊌ ctMap) ctMap'

name: weak_tenvE_refl
pretty: ⊢ ∀tenvE. weak_tenvE tenvE tenvE

name: weak_tenvE_def
pretty:
⊢ ∀tenv tenv'.
    weak_tenvE tenv tenv' ⇔
    num_tvs tenv ≥ num_tvs tenv' ∧
    ∀n inc tvs t. tveLookup n inc tenv' = SOME (tvs,t) ⇔ tveLookup n inc tenv = SOME (tvs,t)

name: weak_tenv_refl
pretty: ⊢ ∀tenv. tenv_val_ok tenv.v ⇒ weak_tenv tenv tenv

name: weak_tenv_extend_dec_tenv
pretty:
⊢ ∀tenv1 tenv2 tenv3.
    tenv_val_ok tenv1.v ∧ weak_tenv tenv2 tenv3 ⇒ weak_tenv (extend_dec_tenv tenv1 tenv2) (extend_dec_tenv tenv1 tenv3)

name: weak_ns_mods_def
pretty:
⊢ ∀impl spec.
    weak_ns_mods impl spec ⇔
    (∀path. nsLookupMod impl path = NONE ⇔ nsLookupMod spec path = NONE) ∧
    ∀mn id. nsLookup impl (Long mn id) = NONE ⇔ nsLookup spec (Long mn id) = NONE

name: weak_extend_dec_tenv
pretty: ⊢ tenv_ok tenv1 ∧ weak tenv2 tenv3 ⇒ weak (extend_dec_tenv tenv1 tenv2) (extend_dec_tenv tenv1 tenv3)

name: weak_def
pretty:
⊢ ∀tenv' tenv.
    weak tenv' tenv ⇔
    tenv'.t = tenv.t ∧ weak_tenv tenv' tenv ∧ weak_ns_mods tenv'.v tenv.v ∧ weak_ns_mods tenv'.c tenv.c

name: type_v_weakening
pretty:
⊢ ∀tvs ctMap tenvS v t.
    type_v tvs ctMap tenvS v t ⇒
    ∀tvs' ctMap' tenvS'.
      (tvs = 0 ∨ tvs = tvs') ∧ weakCT ctMap' ctMap ∧ weakS tenvS' tenvS ⇒ type_v tvs' ctMap' tenvS' v t

name: type_tenv_ctor_weakening
pretty:
⊢ ∀ctMap tenvC envC ctMap'.
    weakCT ctMap' ctMap ∧ nsAll2 (type_ctor ctMap) envC tenvC ⇒ nsAll2 (type_ctor ctMap') envC tenvC

name: type_sv_weakening
pretty:
⊢ ∀ctMap tenvS st sv ctMap' tenvS'.
    type_sv ctMap tenvS sv st ∧ weakCT ctMap' ctMap ∧ weakS tenvS' tenvS ⇒ type_sv ctMap' tenvS' sv st

name: type_shape_weakening
pretty:
⊢ (∀tvs tenv sa t.
     type_shape tvs tenv sa t ⇒
     ∀tenv' tvs'. tvs' ≥ tvs ∧ tenv'.t = tenv.t ∧ weak_tenv tenv' tenv ⇒ type_shape tvs' tenv' sa t) ∧
  ∀tvs tenv sas ts.
    type_shapes tvs tenv sas ts ⇒
    ∀tenv' tvs'. tvs' ≥ tvs ∧ tenv'.t = tenv.t ∧ weak_tenv tenv' tenv ⇒ type_shapes tvs' tenv' sas ts

name: type_s_weakening
pretty: ⊢ ∀ctMap tenvS st ctMap'. type_s ctMap tenvS st ∧ weakCT ctMap' ctMap ⇒ type_s ctMap' tenvS st

name: type_p_weakening
pretty:
⊢ (∀tvs tenv p t bindings.
     type_p tvs tenv p t bindings ⇒
     ∀tenv' tvs'. tvs' ≥ tvs ∧ tenv'.t = tenv.t ∧ weak_tenv tenv' tenv ⇒ type_p tvs' tenv' p t bindings) ∧
  ∀tvs tenv ps ts bindings.
    type_ps tvs tenv ps ts bindings ⇒
    ∀tenv' tvs'. tvs' ≥ tvs ∧ tenv'.t = tenv.t ∧ weak_tenv tenv' tenv ⇒ type_ps tvs' tenv' ps ts bindings

name: type_e_weakening
pretty:
⊢ (∀tenv tenvE e t tenv' tenvE'.
     type_e tenv tenvE e t ∧ weak tenv' tenv ∧ weak_tenvE tenvE' tenvE ⇒ type_e tenv' tenvE' e t) ∧
  (∀tenv tenvE es ts tenv' tenvE'.
     type_es tenv tenvE es ts ∧ weak tenv' tenv ∧ weak_tenvE tenvE' tenvE ⇒ type_es tenv' tenvE' es ts) ∧
  ∀tenv tenvE funs bindings tenv' tenvE'.
    type_funs tenv tenvE funs bindings ∧ weak tenv' tenv ∧ weak_tenvE tenvE' tenvE ⇒
    type_funs tenv' tenvE' funs bindings

name: type_d_weakening
pretty:
⊢ (∀check tenv d decls tenv'.
     type_d check tenv d decls tenv' ⇒
     dopen_free_dec d ⇒
     ∀tenv''. (check ⇔ F) ∧ tenv_ok tenv'' ∧ weak tenv'' tenv ⇒ type_d check tenv'' d decls tenv') ∧
  ∀check tenv d decls tenv'.
    type_ds check tenv d decls tenv' ⇒
    EVERY dopen_free_dec d ⇒
    ∀tenv''. (check ⇔ F) ∧ tenv_ok tenv'' ∧ weak tenv'' tenv ⇒ type_ds check tenv'' d decls tenv'

name: type_all_env_weakening
pretty:
⊢ ∀ctMap tenvS tenv env ctMap' tenvS'.
    weakCT ctMap' ctMap ∧ weakS tenvS' tenvS ∧ type_all_env ctMap tenvS env tenv ⇒ type_all_env ctMap' tenvS' env tenv

name: disjoint_env_weakCT
pretty: ⊢ ∀ctMap ctMap'. DISJOINT (FDOM ctMap') (FDOM ctMap) ⇒ weakCT (ctMap' ⊌ ctMap) ctMap

name: prim_type_sound_invariants
pretty:
⊢ ∀type_ids sem_st prim_env.
    (sem_st,prim_env) = THE (prim_sem_env ffi) ∧ DISJOINT type_ids {Tlist_num; Tbool_num; Texn_num} ⇒
    ∃ctMap.
      type_sound_invariant sem_st prim_env ctMap FEMPTY type_ids prim_tenv ∧
      FRANGE ((SND ∘ SND) o_f ctMap) ⊆ prim_type_ids

name: prim_sem_env_eq
same_type_trans
pretty: ⊢ same_type t1 t2 ∧ same_type t1 t3 ⇒ same_type t2 t3

name: same_type_sym
pretty: ⊢ same_type t1 t2 ⇒ same_type t2 t1

name: RTC_call_FFI_rel_consts
pretty: ⊢ ∀s1 s2. call_FFI_rel꙳ s1 s2 ⇒ s2.oracle = s1.oracle

name: result_rel_list_result
pretty: ⊢ result_rel (LIST_REL R) Q (list_result r1) (list_result r2) ⇔ result_rel R Q r1 r2

name: ptr_eq_sound
pretty:
⊢ evaluate st env [App PtrEq es] = (st',Rval [v]) ⇒
  ∃st1 v1 v2 b.
    evaluate st env (REVERSE es) = (st1,Rval [v2; v1]) ∧
    st' = st1 with ptr_eq_oracle := st1.ptr_eq_oracle⦇0 ↦ shift_seq 1 (st1.ptr_eq_oracle 0)⦈ ∧ v = Boolv b ∧
    (b ⇒ do_eq v1 v2 = Eq_val T)

name: pmatch_not_type_error_EQ
pretty:
⊢ (pmatch envC refs Pany v acc ≠ Match_type_error ⇔ T) ∧ (pmatch envC refs (Pvar n) v acc ≠ Match_type_error ⇔ T) ∧
  (pmatch envC refs (Pcon (SOME name) xs) v acc ≠ Match_type_error ⇔
   ∃ys t l stamp.
     v = Conv (SOME t) ys ∧ nsLookup envC name = SOME (l,stamp) ∧ LENGTH xs = l ∧ same_type stamp t ∧
     (t = stamp ⇒ l = LENGTH ys ∧ pmatch_list envC refs xs ys acc ≠ Match_type_error)) ∧
  (pmatch envC refs (Pcon NONE xs) v acc ≠ Match_type_error ⇔
   ∃ys. v = Conv NONE ys ∧ LENGTH xs = LENGTH ys ∧ pmatch_list envC refs xs ys acc ≠ Match_type_error) ∧
  (pmatch_list envC refs [] [] acc ≠ Match_type_error ⇔ T) ∧
  (pmatch_list envC refs [] (v::vs) acc ≠ Match_type_error ⇔ F) ∧
  (pmatch_list envC refs (p::ps) [] acc ≠ Match_type_error ⇔ F) ∧
  (pmatch_list envC refs (p::ps) (v::vs) acc ≠ Match_type_error ⇔
   pmatch envC refs p v acc ≠ Match_type_error ∧
   (∀a. pmatch envC refs p v acc = No_match ⇒ pmatch_list envC refs ps vs acc ≠ Match_type_error) ∧
   ∀a. pmatch envC refs p v acc = Match a ⇒ pmatch_list envC refs ps vs a ≠ Match_type_error)

name: pair_CASE_eq_forall
pretty: ⊢ (case x of (a,b) => P a b) ⇔ ∀a b. x = (a,b) ⇒ P a b

name: no_ptr_eq_ind
pretty:
⊢ ∀P. (∀e. P e ⇒ P (Raise e)) ∧ (∀e pes. (∀p e'. MEM (p,e') pes ⇒ P e') ∧ P e ⇒ P (Handle e pes)) ∧ (∀l. P (Lit l)) ∧
      (∀cn es. (∀x. MEM x es ⇒ P x) ⇒ P (Con cn es)) ∧ (∀n. P (Var n)) ∧ (∀n e. P (Fun n e)) ∧
      (∀op es. (∀x. MEM x es ⇒ P x) ⇒ P (App op es)) ∧ (∀op e1 e2. P e1 ∧ P e2 ⇒ P (Log op e1 e2)) ∧
      (∀e1 e2 e3. P e1 ∧ P e2 ∧ P e3 ⇒ P (If e1 e2 e3)) ∧
      (∀e pes. (∀p e'. MEM (p,e') pes ⇒ P e') ∧ P e ⇒ P (Mat e pes)) ∧ (∀n e1 e2. P e1 ∧ P e2 ⇒ P (Let n e1 e2)) ∧
      (∀funs e. P e ⇒ P (Letrec funs e)) ∧ (∀e t. P e ⇒ P (Tannot e t)) ∧ (∀e l. P e ⇒ P (Lannot e l)) ∧
      (∀path e. P e ⇒ P (Open path e)) ∧ (∀e sa. P e ⇒ P (Assert e sa)) ⇒
      ∀v. P v

name: no_ptr_eq_def_primitive
pretty:
⊢ no_ptr_eq =
  WFREC
    (@R. WF R ∧ (∀e. R e (Raise e)) ∧ (∀pes e. R e (Handle e pes)) ∧
         (∀e pes p e'. MEM (p,e') pes ⇒ R e' (Handle e pes)) ∧ (∀cn es x. MEM x es ⇒ R x (Con cn es)) ∧
         (∀op es x. MEM x es ⇒ R x (App op es)) ∧ (∀e1 op e2. R e2 (Log op e1 e2)) ∧ (∀e2 op e1. R e1 (Log op e1 e2)) ∧
         (∀e2 e1 e3. R e3 (If e1 e2 e3)) ∧ (∀e3 e1 e2. R e2 (If e1 e2 e3)) ∧ (∀e3 e2 e1. R e1 (If e1 e2 e3)) ∧
         (∀pes e. R e (Mat e pes)) ∧ (∀e pes p e'. MEM (p,e') pes ⇒ R e' (Mat e pes)) ∧ (∀e1 n e2. R e2 (Let n e1 e2)) ∧
         (∀e2 n e1. R e1 (Let n e1 e2)) ∧ (∀funs e. R e (Letrec funs e)) ∧ (∀t e. R e (Tannot e t)) ∧
         (∀l e. R e (Lannot e l)) ∧ (∀path e. R e (Open path e)) ∧ ∀sa e. R e (Assert e sa))
    (λno_ptr_eq a.
       case a of
         Raise e => I (no_ptr_eq e)
       | Handle e' pes => I (no_ptr_eq e' ∧ EVERY (λ(p,e). no_ptr_eq e) pes)
       | Lit l => I T
       | Con cn es => I (EVERY no_ptr_eq es)
       | Var n => I T
       | Fun n' e'' => I T
       | App op es' => I (op ≠ Opapp ∧ op ≠ ThunkOp ForceThunk ∧ op ≠ Eval ∧ op ≠ PtrEq ∧ EVERY no_ptr_eq es')
       | Log op' e1 e2 => I (no_ptr_eq e1 ∧ no_ptr_eq e2)
       | If e1' e2' e3 => I (no_ptr_eq e1' ∧ no_ptr_eq e2' ∧ no_ptr_eq e3)
       | Mat e'³' pes' => I (no_ptr_eq e'³' ∧ EVERY (λ(p,e). no_ptr_eq e) pes')
       | Let n'' e1'' e2'' => I (no_ptr_eq e1'' ∧ no_ptr_eq e2'')
       | Letrec funs e'⁴' => I (no_ptr_eq e'⁴')
       | Tannot e'⁵' t => I (no_ptr_eq e'⁵')
       | Lannot e'⁶' l' => I (no_ptr_eq e'⁶')
       | Open path e'⁷' => I (no_ptr_eq e'⁷')
       | Assert e'⁸' sa => I (no_ptr_eq e'⁸'))

name: no_ptr_eq_def
pretty:
⊢ (∀e. no_ptr_eq (Raise e) ⇔ no_ptr_eq e) ∧
  (∀pes e. no_ptr_eq (Handle e pes) ⇔ no_ptr_eq e ∧ EVERY (λ(p,e'). no_ptr_eq e') pes) ∧ (∀l. no_ptr_eq (Lit l) ⇔ T) ∧
  (∀es cn. no_ptr_eq (Con cn es) ⇔ EVERY no_ptr_eq es) ∧ (∀n. no_ptr_eq (Var n) ⇔ T) ∧ (∀n e. no_ptr_eq (Fun n e) ⇔ T) ∧
  (∀op es. no_ptr_eq (App op es) ⇔ op ≠ Opapp ∧ op ≠ ThunkOp ForceThunk ∧ op ≠ Eval ∧ op ≠ PtrEq ∧ EVERY no_ptr_eq es) ∧
  (∀op e2 e1. no_ptr_eq (Log op e1 e2) ⇔ no_ptr_eq e1 ∧ no_ptr_eq e2) ∧
  (∀e3 e2 e1. no_ptr_eq (If e1 e2 e3) ⇔ no_ptr_eq e1 ∧ no_ptr_eq e2 ∧ no_ptr_eq e3) ∧
  (∀pes e. no_ptr_eq (Mat e pes) ⇔ no_ptr_eq e ∧ EVERY (λ(p,e'). no_ptr_eq e') pes) ∧
  (∀n e2 e1. no_ptr_eq (Let n e1 e2) ⇔ no_ptr_eq e1 ∧ no_ptr_eq e2) ∧
  (∀funs e. no_ptr_eq (Letrec funs e) ⇔ no_ptr_eq e) ∧ (∀t e. no_ptr_eq (Tannot e t) ⇔ no_ptr_eq e) ∧
  (∀l e. no_ptr_eq (Lannot e l) ⇔ no_ptr_eq e) ∧ (∀path e. no_ptr_eq (Open path e) ⇔ no_ptr_eq e) ∧
  ∀sa e. no_ptr_eq (Assert e sa) ⇔ no_ptr_eq e

name: list_result_inj
pretty: ⊢ list_result x = list_result y ⇒ x = y

name: list_result_eq_Rval
pretty: ⊢ list_result r = Rval r' ⇔ ∃v. r' = [v] ∧ r = Rval v

name: list_result_eq_Rerr
pretty: ⊢ list_result r = Rerr e ⇔ r = Rerr e

name: is_clock_io_mono_set_clock
pretty:
⊢ is_clock_io_mono f s ⇒
  f s = (s',r) ∧ r ≠ Rerr (Rabort Rtimeout_error) ⇒
  ∃ck0. f (s with clock := ck0) = (s' with clock := ck1,r)

name: is_clock_io_mono_return
pretty: ⊢ is_clock_io_mono (λs. (s,Rval r)) s

name: is_clock_io_mono_option_case_safe
pretty:
⊢ (∀st clk. f (st with clock := clk) = f st) ∧
  is_clock_io_mono (λst'. case f st of NONE => g st' | SOME x => h x st') st ⇒
  is_clock_io_mono (λst'. case f st' of NONE => g st' | SOME x => h x st') st

name: is_clock_io_mono_minimal
pretty:
⊢ is_clock_io_mono f s ⇒
  f s = (s',r) ∧ s'.clock = 0 ∧ r ≠ Rerr (Rabort Rtimeout_error) ∧ s.clock > k ⇒
  ∃s''. f (s with clock := k) = (s'',Rerr (Rabort Rtimeout_error)) ∧ io_events_mono s''.ffi s'.ffi

name: is_clock_io_mono_match_case_safe
pretty:
⊢ (∀st clk. f (st with clock := clk) = f st) ∧
  is_clock_io_mono (λst'. case f st of No_match => g st' | Match_type_error => h st' | Match env => j env st') st ⇒
  is_clock_io_mono (λst'. case f st' of No_match => g st' | Match_type_error => h st' | Match env => j env st') st

name: is_clock_io_mono_match_case_pair_safe
pretty:
⊢ (∀st clk. f (st with clock := clk) = f st) ∧
  is_clock_io_mono (λst'. (st',case f st of No_match => g st' | Match_type_error => h st' | Match env => j env st')) st ⇒
  is_clock_io_mono (λst'. (st',case f st' of No_match => g st' | Match_type_error => h st' | Match env => j env st')) st

name: is_clock_io_mono_if_safe
pretty:
⊢ (∀st clk. f (st with clock := clk) ⇔ f st) ∧ is_clock_io_mono (λst'. if f st then j st' else k st') st ⇒
  is_clock_io_mono (λst'. if f st' then j st' else k st') st

name: is_clock_io_mono_extra_mono
pretty: ⊢ (∀s. is_clock_io_mono f s) ⇒ io_events_mono (FST (f s)).ffi (FST (f (s with clock := s.clock + extra))).ffi

name: is_clock_io_mono_extra
pretty:
⊢ (∀s. is_clock_io_mono f s) ⇒
  f s = (s',r) ∧ r ≠ Rerr (Rabort Rtimeout_error) ⇒
  f (s with clock := s.clock + extra) = (s' with clock := s'.clock + extra,r)

name: is_clock_io_mono_evaluate_decs
pretty: ⊢ ∀s e p. is_clock_io_mono (λs. evaluate_decs s e p) s

name: is_clock_io_mono_evaluate
pretty:
⊢ (∀s env es. is_clock_io_mono (λs. evaluate s env es) s) ∧
  (∀s env v pes err_v. is_clock_io_mono (λs. evaluate_match s env v pes err_v) s) ∧
  ∀s env ds. is_clock_io_mono (λs. evaluate_decs s env ds) s

name: is_clock_io_mono_err
pretty: ⊢ is_clock_io_mono (λs. (s,Rerr r)) s

name: is_clock_io_mono_do_app_simple
pretty:
⊢ ∀xs st.
    is_clock_io_mono
      (λst'.
         case do_app (st'.refs,st'.ffi) op xs of
           NONE => (st',Rerr (Rabort Rtype_error))
         | SOME ((refs,ffi),r) => (st' with <|refs := refs; ffi := ffi|>,list_result r)) st

name: is_clock_io_mono_def
pretty:
⊢ ∀f s.
    is_clock_io_mono f s ⇔
    case f s of
      (s',r) =>
        io_events_mono s.ffi s'.ffi ∧ s'.clock ≤ s.clock ∧ s.next_type_stamp ≤ s'.next_type_stamp ∧
        s.next_exn_stamp ≤ s'.next_exn_stamp ∧ LENGTH s.refs ≤ LENGTH s'.refs ∧
        ∀clk.
          case f (s with clock := clk) of
            (s'',r') =>
              (r' ≠ Rerr (Rabort Rtimeout_error) ⇒
               r ≠ Rerr (Rabort Rtimeout_error) ⇒
               r' = r ∧ s'' = s' with clock := clk − (s.clock − s'.clock)) ∧
              (r ≠ Rerr (Rabort Rtimeout_error) ⇒ (clk ≥ s.clock − s'.clock ⇔ r' ≠ Rerr (Rabort Rtimeout_error))) ∧
              (r' ≠ Rerr (Rabort Rtimeout_error) ⇒ clk ≤ s.clock ⇒ r ≠ Rerr (Rabort Rtimeout_error)) ∧
              (clk ≤ s.clock ⇒ io_events_mono s''.ffi s'.ffi)

name: is_clock_io_mono_cong
pretty:
⊢ s = t ⇒
  (∀s. s.eval_state = t.eval_state ∧ s.refs = t.refs ∧ s.ffi = t.ffi ⇒ f s = g s) ⇒
  (is_clock_io_mono f s ⇔ is_clock_io_mono g t)

name: is_clock_io_mono_check
pretty:
⊢ (s.clock ≠ 0 ⇒ is_clock_io_mono (λs. f (adj_clock 1 0 s)) (dec_clock s)) ⇒
  is_clock_io_mono (λs. if s.clock = 0 then (s,Rerr (Rabort Rtimeout_error)) else f s) s

name: is_clock_io_mono_bind
pretty:
⊢ is_clock_io_mono f s ∧ (∀s' r. f s = (s',r) ⇒ is_clock_io_mono (g r) s') ∧
  (∀s'. g (Rerr (Rabort Rtimeout_error)) s' = (s',Rerr (Rabort Rtimeout_error))) ⇒
  is_clock_io_mono (λs. case f s of (s',r) => g r s') s

name: is_clock_io_mono_acc_safe
pretty:
⊢ ∀v g.
    (∀st clk. f (st with clock := clk) = f st) ∧ (f st = v ∨ f st ≠ v) ∧ is_clock_io_mono (λst'. g (f st) st') st ⇒
    is_clock_io_mono (λst'. g (f st') st') st

name: io_events_mono_trans
pretty: ⊢ io_events_mono ffi1 ffi2 ∧ io_events_mono ffi2 ffi3 ⇒ io_events_mono ffi1 ffi3

name: io_events_mono_refl
pretty: ⊢ io_events_mono ffi ffi

name: io_events_mono_def
pretty: ⊢ ∀s1 s2. io_events_mono s1 s2 ⇔ s1.io_events ≼ s2.io_events ∧ (s2.io_events = s1.io_events ⇒ s2 = s1)

name: io_events_mono_antisym
pretty: ⊢ io_events_mono s1 s2 ∧ io_events_mono s2 s1 ⇒ s1 = s2

name: evaluate_sing
pretty: ⊢ ∀s env e s' vs. evaluate s env [e] = (s',Rval vs) ⇒ ∃v. vs = [v]

name: evaluate_set_next_stamps
pretty:
⊢ (∀s0 env xs s1 res.
     evaluate s0 env xs = (s1,res) ⇒
     (s1.next_type_stamp = s0.next_type_stamp ⇒
      ∀k. evaluate (s0 with next_type_stamp := k) env xs = (s1 with next_type_stamp := k,res)) ∧
     (s1.next_exn_stamp = s0.next_exn_stamp ⇒
      ∀k. evaluate (s0 with next_exn_stamp := k) env xs = (s1 with next_exn_stamp := k,res))) ∧
  (∀s0 env v pes errv s1 res.
     evaluate_match s0 env v pes errv = (s1,res) ⇒
     (s1.next_type_stamp = s0.next_type_stamp ⇒
      ∀k. evaluate_match (s0 with next_type_stamp := k) env v pes errv = (s1 with next_type_stamp := k,res)) ∧
     (s1.next_exn_stamp = s0.next_exn_stamp ⇒
      ∀k. evaluate_match (s0 with next_exn_stamp := k) env v pes errv = (s1 with next_exn_stamp := k,res))) ∧
  ∀s0 env ds s1 res.
    evaluate_decs s0 env ds = (s1,res) ⇒
    (s1.next_type_stamp = s0.next_type_stamp ⇒
     ∀k. evaluate_decs (s0 with next_type_stamp := k) env ds = (s1 with next_type_stamp := k,res)) ∧
    (s1.next_exn_stamp = s0.next_exn_stamp ⇒
     ∀k. evaluate_decs (s0 with next_exn_stamp := k) env ds = (s1 with next_exn_stamp := k,res))

name: evaluate_set_init_clock
pretty:
⊢ evaluate st env xs = (st',res) ∧ res ≠ Rerr (Rabort Rtimeout_error) ⇒
  ∀k. ∃ck res1 st1.
    evaluate (st with clock := k) env xs = (st1,res1) ∧
    (res1 = res ∧ st1 = st' with clock := ck ∨ res1 = Rerr (Rabort Rtimeout_error) ∧ io_events_mono st1.ffi st'.ffi)

name: evaluate_set_clock
pretty:
⊢ ∀s env exps s1 res.
    evaluate s env exps = (s1,res) ∧ res ≠ Rerr (Rabort Rtimeout_error) ⇒
    ∀ck. ∃ck1. evaluate (s with clock := ck1) env exps = (s1 with clock := ck,res)

name: evaluate_refs_length_mono
pretty:
⊢ (∀s env es s' r. evaluate s env es = (s',r) ⇒ LENGTH s.refs ≤ LENGTH s'.refs) ∧
  ∀s env v pes err_v s' r. evaluate_match s env v pes err_v = (s',r) ⇒ LENGTH s.refs ≤ LENGTH s'.refs

name: evaluate_no_ptr_eq_with_oracle
pretty:
⊢ no_ptr_eq e ∧ evaluate st env [e] = (st',res) ⇒
  evaluate (st with ptr_eq_oracle := oracle) env [e] = (st' with ptr_eq_oracle := oracle,res)

name: evaluate_no_ptr_eq_preserves_oracle
pretty: ⊢ no_ptr_eq e ∧ evaluate st env [e] = (st',res) ⇒ st'.ptr_eq_oracle = st.ptr_eq_oracle

name: evaluate_no_ptr_eq
pretty:
⊢ (∀st env es st' res.
     EVERY no_ptr_eq es ∧ evaluate st env es = (st',res) ⇒
     st'.ptr_eq_oracle = st.ptr_eq_oracle ∧
     ∀oracle. evaluate (st with ptr_eq_oracle := oracle) env es = (st' with ptr_eq_oracle := oracle,res)) ∧
  ∀st env v pes err_v st' res.
    EVERY (λ(p,e). no_ptr_eq e) pes ∧ evaluate_match st env v pes err_v = (st',res) ⇒
    st'.ptr_eq_oracle = st.ptr_eq_oracle ∧
    ∀oracle. evaluate_match (st with ptr_eq_oracle := oracle) env v pes err_v = (st' with ptr_eq_oracle := oracle,res)

name: evaluate_nil
pretty: ⊢ ∀s env. evaluate s env [] = (s,Rval [])

name: evaluate_next_type_stamp_mono
pretty:
⊢ (evaluate s env es = (s',res1) ⇒ s.next_type_stamp ≤ s'.next_type_stamp) ∧
  (evaluate_match s env v pes err_v = (s',res2) ⇒ s.next_type_stamp ≤ s'.next_type_stamp) ∧
  (evaluate_decs s env ds = (s',res3) ⇒ s.next_type_stamp ≤ s'.next_type_stamp)

name: evaluate_next_exn_stamp_mono
pretty:
⊢ (evaluate s env es = (s',res1) ⇒ s.next_exn_stamp ≤ s'.next_exn_stamp) ∧
  (evaluate_match s env v pes err_v = (s',res2) ⇒ s.next_exn_stamp ≤ s'.next_exn_stamp) ∧
  (evaluate_decs s env ds = (s',res3) ⇒ s.next_exn_stamp ≤ s'.next_exn_stamp)

name: evaluate_minimal_clock
pretty:
⊢ ∀s env es s' r k.
    evaluate s env es = (s',r) ∧ s'.clock = 0 ∧ r ≠ Rerr (Rabort Rtimeout_error) ∧ s.clock > k ⇒
    ∃s''. evaluate (s with clock := k) env es = (s'',Rerr (Rabort Rtimeout_error)) ∧ io_events_mono s''.ffi s'.ffi

name: evaluate_match_minimal_clock
pretty:
⊢ ∀s env v pes err_v s' r k.
    evaluate_match s env v pes err_v = (s',r) ∧ s'.clock = 0 ∧ r ≠ Rerr (Rabort Rtimeout_error) ∧ s.clock > k ⇒
    ∃s''.
      evaluate_match (s with clock := k) env v pes err_v = (s'',Rerr (Rabort Rtimeout_error)) ∧
      io_events_mono s''.ffi s'.ffi

name: evaluate_match_list_result
pretty: ⊢ evaluate_match s e v p er = (s',r) ⇒ ∃r'. r = list_result r'

name: evaluate_match_add_to_clock
pretty:
⊢ ∀s env v pes err_v s' r extra.
    evaluate_match s env v pes err_v = (s',r) ∧ r ≠ Rerr (Rabort Rtimeout_error) ⇒
    evaluate_match (s with clock := s.clock + extra) env v pes err_v = (s' with clock := s'.clock + extra,r)

name: evaluate_letrec_duplicate
pretty: ⊢ ¬ALL_DISTINCT (MAP FST funs) ⇒ evaluate s env [Letrec funs body] = (s,Rerr (Rabort Rtype_error))

name: evaluate_letrec_distinct
pretty:
⊢ ALL_DISTINCT (MAP (λ(f,x,e). f) funs) ⇒
  evaluate s env [Letrec funs body] = evaluate s (env with v := build_rec_env funs env env.v) [body]

name: evaluate_let_known_value
pretty:
⊢ evaluate s env [rhs] = (s,Rval [value]) ⇒
  evaluate s env [Let (SOME name) rhs body] = evaluate s (env with v := nsBind name value env.v) [body]

name: evaluate_length
pretty:
⊢ (∀s e p s' r. evaluate s e p = (s',Rval r) ⇒ LENGTH r = LENGTH p) ∧
  (∀s e v p er s' r. evaluate_match s e v p er = (s',Rval r) ⇒ LENGTH r = 1) ∧
  ∀s e ds s' r. evaluate_decs s e ds = (s',Rval r) ⇒ T

name: evaluate_known_value_list
pretty: ⊢ ∀es vs. LIST_REL (λe v. ∀s. evaluate s env [e] = (s,Rval [v])) es vs ⇒ ∀s. evaluate s env es = (s,Rval vs)

name: evaluate_io_events_mono_imp
pretty:
⊢ (∀s e p s' r. evaluate s e p = (s',r) ⇒ io_events_mono s.ffi s'.ffi) ∧
  (∀s e v pes errv s' r. evaluate_match s e v pes errv = (s',r) ⇒ io_events_mono s.ffi s'.ffi) ∧
  ∀s e p s' r. evaluate_decs s e p = (s',r) ⇒ io_events_mono s.ffi s'.ffi

name: evaluate_io_events_mono
pretty:
⊢ (∀s e exp. io_events_mono s.ffi (FST (evaluate s e exp)).ffi) ∧
  (∀s e v pes errv. io_events_mono s.ffi (FST (evaluate_match s e v pes errv)).ffi) ∧
  ∀s e d. io_events_mono s.ffi (FST (evaluate_decs s e d)).ffi

name: evaluate_history_irrelevance
pretty:
⊢ (∀st env exp st' res.
     evaluate st env exp = (st',res) ⇒
     ∃new_io.
       st'.ffi.io_events = st.ffi.io_events ++ new_io ∧
       ∀l. evaluate (st with ffi := st.ffi with io_events := l) env exp =
           (st' with ffi := st'.ffi with io_events := l ++ new_io,res)) ∧
  (∀st env v pes err_v st' res.
     evaluate_match st env v pes err_v = (st',res) ⇒
     ∃new_io.
       st'.ffi.io_events = st.ffi.io_events ++ new_io ∧
       ∀l. evaluate_match (st with ffi := st.ffi with io_events := l) env v pes err_v =
           (st' with ffi := st'.ffi with io_events := l ++ new_io,res)) ∧
  ∀st env ds st' res.

name: prim_canonical_values_thm
pretty:
⊢ (type_v tvs ctMap tenvS v Tint ∧ ctMap_ok ctMap ⇒ ∃n. v = Litv (IntLit n)) ∧

   ∃n vs.
     v = Loc T n ∧ store_lookup n envS = SOME (Varray vs) ∧ EVERY (λv. type_v 0 ctMap tenvS v t) vs ∧
     FLOOKUP tenvS n = SOME (Varray_t t)) ∧

name: pat_type_sound

     LIST_REL (λ(x,v) (x',t). x = x' ∧ type_v tvs ctMap tenvS v t) bindings tbindings ⇒
     pmatch cenv st p v bindings = No_match ∨
     ∃bindings'.
       pmatch cenv st p v bindings = Match bindings' ∧
       LIST_REL (λ(x,v) (x',t). x = x' ∧ type_v tvs ctMap tenvS v t) bindings' (new_tbindings ++ tbindings)) ∧
  ∀cenv st ps vs bindings tenv ctMap tbindings new_tbindings ts tenvS tvs.
    ctMap_ok ctMap ∧ nsAll2 (type_ctor ctMap) cenv tenv.c ∧ LIST_REL (type_v tvs ctMap tenvS) vs ts ∧
    type_ps tvs tenv ps ts new_tbindings ∧ type_s ctMap st tenvS ∧
    LIST_REL (λ(x,v) (x',t). x = x' ∧ type_v tvs ctMap tenvS v t) bindings tbindings ⇒
    pmatch_list cenv st ps vs bindings = No_match ∨

      LIST_REL (λ(x,v) (x',t). x = x' ∧ type_v tvs ctMap tenvS v t) bindings' (new_tbindings ++ tbindings)

name: op_type_sound

name: exp_type_sound
pretty:
⊢ (∀s env es r s' tenv tenvE ts tvs tenvS.

     (tvs ≠ 0 ⇒ EVERY is_value es) ∧ type_es tenv (bind_tvar tvs tenvE) es ts ⇒

name: datatype_allocation_type_sound_retarget
pretty:
⊢ ALL_DISTINCT type_identities ∧ DISJOINT (set type_identities) (set (Tlist_num::Tbool_num::prim_type_nums)) ∧
  LENGTH type_identities = LENGTH tds ∧
  tenvT = alist_to_ns (MAP2 (λ(tvs,tn,ctors) ti. (tn,tvs,Tapp (MAP Tvar tvs) ti)) tds type_identities) ∧
  check_ctor_tenv (nsAppend tenvT tenv.t) tds ∧ type_sound_invariant st env ctMap tenvS ∅ tenv ∧
  DISJOINT (set type_identities) (FRANGE ((SND ∘ SND) o_f ctMap)) ∧ tenv_ok target_tenv ∧
  target_tenv.c = nsAppend (build_ctor_tenv (nsAppend tenvT tenv.t) tds type_identities) tenv.c ∧ target_tenv.v = tenv.v ⇒
  (let
     allocated = FEMPTY |++ REVERSE (type_def_to_ctMap (nsAppend tenvT tenv.t) st.next_type_stamp tds type_identities);
     ctMap' = allocated ⊌ ctMap;
     env' = <|v := nsEmpty; c := build_tdefs st.next_type_stamp tds|>;
     tenv' = <|v := nsEmpty; c := build_ctor_tenv (nsAppend tenvT tenv.t) tds type_identities; t := tenvT|>
   in
     weakCT ctMap' ctMap ∧ FRANGE ((SND ∘ SND) o_f ctMap') DIFF FRANGE ((SND ∘ SND) o_f ctMap) ⊆ set type_identities ∧
     preserves_datatype_signatures (set type_identities) ctMap ctMap' ∧

     type_all_env ctMap' tenvS env' tenv' ∧
     type_sound_invariant (st with next_type_stamp := st.next_type_stamp + LENGTH tds) (env' +++ env) ctMap' tenvS ∅
       target_tenv)

name: ctor_canonical_values_thm
pretty:
⊢ (type_v tvs ctMap tenvS v Tbool ∧ ctMap_ok ctMap ∧ ctMap_has_bools ctMap ⇒ ∃b. v = Boolv b) ∧
  (type_v tvs ctMap tenvS v (Tlist t) ∧ ctMap_ok ctMap ∧ ctMap_has_lists ctMap ⇒
